| 🗞️In the News 🗞️: Colorado PDAB Sets Nation's First UPL
---
| Friends-
On October 3rd, members of Colorado's Prescription Drug Affordability Board (PDAB) voted unanimously to set an Upper Payment Limit (UPL) on Enbrel, a prescription drug used to treat rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, and other conditions. The drug was deemed "unaffordable" by the board, and the UPL was set at $600 per 50mg/1ML unit, with the potential to save [$32 million](https://dpxqxvhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001sNbX148tk9dyBNTwbxxXl4eBRmtZ50fZsfU8ODExvwPN5yv3W42_MZlO4aHhyZOjVqjsYRQ68k8vNauPKpjApbwA_0_6H-zI9h5vUPiwmD0TD3IUOlK9f3FIfD5QzbgiBfSLiXdxXEKdxT8SsKi5nS6ayP5Z-VLkannYUGqpLIlYYsVgxriIfM3_fVNzp739l3Nv0RLcAsp3tHbzquR04MzyPEQwizMhirf-b7njUqqpZWBGz6QsAw173UZOX5EfVcT4pFwfVB7bSMA_fdj0tKCMuelAGp0zT7CJEAQ4G3-YDbYT2euEGHzaZMCjeji3fJ5lsI5BYJezeZoI7dr65nhrLq1G5J-nplDgze3z9dF1g0Qr3uXNhAHaevmGYG8K&c=JxLmql886AMhRw8IGoEy4-orGPyFz_vxW3bjeE-eVZwSO9z1InLZsQ==&ch=3VZ5yC4Q92j0VgE_KydefohUtPp5qZCHgjxll5zJLEk6BIOf1006Cw==). This is the same price that was negotiated at the Federal level for use in Medicare Part D as part of the Inflation Reduction Act's historic reforms to lower costs. This action makes Colorado the first state in the country with a Prescription Drug Affordability Board to set an Upper Payment Limit on a prescription drug.

| Legislation to create a Prescription Drug Affordability Board in Virginia was passed in 2024 and 2025, but was vetoed both years by Governor Youngkin. This legislation is sorely needed in Virginia, with [1 of 4 Virginians](https://dpxqxvhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001sNbX148tk9dyBNTwbxxXl4eBRmtZ50fZsfU8ODExvwPN5yv3W42_MZlO4aHhyZOjehL0dbXb4yGCex_118bvbFO8Kz8Ht_hzd3rIpIfFDTn725g2Q9e4Lj4BnMpZs-h7YlrvyAQcflzcspOPcj47q8qQn5-28vhyG_YAfj3ntYwYH9cv2SL0MqEF2av3bG8T5l4GtsAB8Bs3iD670iu9fnhcEPhd7PnjDr9uab5elUs0tNhviYZ8s0Cv118_zqqqRNGlaY9V8kEDwKOHAyTZCrmQS1KC0ASSNv0GMMqJI63P0d4Fn7sC0Yzzd5oaKo8cw8YkHc8i3GU=&c=JxLmql886AMhRw8IGoEy4-orGPyFz_vxW3bjeE-eVZwSO9z1InLZsQ==&ch=3VZ5yC4Q92j0VgE_KydefohUtPp5qZCHgjxll5zJLEk6BIOf1006Cw==) who rely on prescription medications choosing not to take them simply because they cannot afford them. And with prescription drug costs rising [above the rate of inflation](https://dpxqxvhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001sNbX148tk9dyBNTwbxxXl4eBRmtZ50fZsfU8ODExvwPN5yv3W42_MZlO4aHhyZOjGue7fckZYk4ToJhxLlPTuJZAqV-cdK6HiTTEIru3WVa0TNMD4GmLXCDdSc8hVNmNp6JV5HxYuK_agq_H3q5-3Ji4Dy7H_TWR4O2Al6eP1SfBS33Z5xXg4nEfjdjq2ic_iSlR3OIRAj3Tt32J6iQKF_-k02Hp5Zf7z9iXRrNTp3MLsBM9J_AtDpXKUdVLo8VkJo10Tygutbzy8zdLLkZwKcsakjMVnsYtQ7FKv2K9wuX3dEkITgLmC9xu7oDJuEjME1ISWhWk11ji5F_i-VO4dm4IOl6yejAiIRzSQBS4TaCG9_MIvXIIqXCS4ls0I5MevwswWzpJtng=&c=JxLmql886AMhRw8IGoEy4-orGPyFz_vxW3bjeE-eVZwSO9z1InLZsQ==&ch=3VZ5yC4Q92j0VgE_KydefohUtPp5qZCHgjxll5zJLEk6BIOf1006Cw==), Virginians are more supportive than ever of a Prescription Drug Affordability Board to help combat the rising cost of living. A [recent poll](https://dpxqxvhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001sNbX148tk9dyBNTwbxxXl4eBRmtZ50fZsfU8ODExvwPN5yv3W42_MZlO4aHhyZOjH8cE0aUfo1neXgY08evfgpGkG65BmPDT0uA0IH-XUR0QwYG7bDmMWx6tz3N8K-Kpn2nbbAH3prEJJ-o_Tlr-h25Cs9uwdO6RrMeSxxQQWLz6W8idkdjl-ZZEDo4bZSMj3Jx9C1mveQsIfR3xMh0PeKZb-O8l95TeJHq20hOwymZGJrtRzK_ZGg==&c=JxLmql886AMhRw8IGoEy4-orGPyFz_vxW3bjeE-eVZwSO9z1InLZsQ==&ch=3VZ5yC4Q92j0VgE_KydefohUtPp5qZCHgjxll5zJLEk6BIOf1006Cw==) by AARP showed that Virginia voters of all political ideologies support legislation to create a Prescription Drug Affordability Board. Support includes 76% of voters identifying as conservatives, 92% of liberals and 86% of moderates.
Virginia has the chance this legislative session to follow Colorado's lead and start making access to affordable prescription drugs a reality for everyone. It's time for a Prescription Drug Affordability Board in Virginia.
Natalie Jones Communications Director

subject: The mistake I made:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
You know, I made a mistake early on:
From all the movies that we see growing up about heroes and villains, I thought that fascist takeover attempts were going to be architected by evil _geniuses._
I was not expecting how unearned, nepotistic, mediocre, and just dumb so many of the people architecting this were going to be and it works because of brute force.
You can do anything through brute force, but it's not sophisticated and it does not merit our intellectual respect.
**That's my thought of the day.**
And even to that, that's why the right says: “you were a bartender, you were a bartender” to kind of project their insecurities onto me, but, I did something. I ran for Congress and won because of the incredible support from my neighbors.
Republicans want us to resign ourselves to cynicism but giving up is a privilege we can’t afford. Through solidarity we can make a new world, a better country, where our work has dignity and our lives have respect.
I can’t do this work without you — the grassroots supporters who have had my back every step of the way. I don't curry favor with billionaires or host exclusive fundraising events. This campaign's average donation floats around $17-20.
Together, we’ve built a movement that won’t back down. Thank you for being a part of it.

#

**_“5X MATCH NOW...”
“Donald Trump is FINISHED”
“Did you abandon us???”_**
Peter, if your email inbox looks like this, you’re not alone.
It seems like every day we’re bombarded with emails from political campaigns or advocacy organizations, some of which we may not have even heard of.
We know it’s a lot. And it’s why Jon and our team work really hard to make sure our messages aren’t like that.
And the fact that you even opened this email gives us hope it’s working. _Thank you._
So before we ask you to make a contribution (and yes, we are going to ask...) we wanted to lay out, simply and clearly, why we’re asking for your help so urgently.
Here it is:
Jon won his last race by just over 1%, and this race is likely to be just as close.
_Cook Political Report_ and _Inside Elections_ have both rated this race a “TOSS-UP” and the GOP sees Georgia as their single best opportunity to pick up a Senate seat — and lock in their pro-Trump majority — in the midterms.
The GOP and their Super PACs have already spent more than $10 million on this race. And Jon’s opponents are raising millions on top of that.
We know that if we stand together, we can fight back and win. _But it ONLY works if everyone steps up and gets involved however they can._
[**So if winning this race — and stopping a MAGA takeover of our country — matters to you, we’re asking you to give $5 to Jon Ossoff’s reelection campaign today. body:
I hope I made you proud.

I just stepped offstage, and I wanted to quickly reach out.

On that debate stage, it was clear Jack Ciattarelli thinks he can flip New Jersey red by attacking me with one lie after another about my record — and trying to hide the facts about his own.

**But tonight, I fought back. I laid out my vision for our future directly to the people of New Jersey: a future in which families get desperately needed relief from rising utility bills, grocery bills, and health care costs, and in which defending the freedoms of New Jersey families comes before doing the bidding of ANY politician or president.**

And I set the record straight for the people of New Jersey.

When Jack tried to spread more of the same tired falsehoods, I stood proudly behind my record of serving our nation in uniform — something Jack never did.

And when he attempted to mislead people about his long track record of trying to raise costs on hardworking families, I reminded the people of New Jersey that, just _last week_ , Jack’s running mate said new taxes would be “on the table” in their administration for everyone in our state except millionaires.

**I hope I made you proud tonight, and I’m so grateful for your support. We could never have gotten this far without the tireless work of this grassroots team — and I’m truly honored to have you standing with me.**

Friend, Civil rights groups just filed a **federal class-action lawsuit** exposing a secret, sprawling data operation within the Trump administration: a system that consolidates **Social Security numbers, medical records, biometric data, even children's case files** across multiple federal agencies. **All without public notice. A message to young Latinos:
Half of all new eligible voters in the U.S. are Latino, and here in California, nearly one in three eligible Latino voters is between the ages of 18 and 34 . That makes us one of the youngest and fastest-growing voting groups in the country, which means young Latinos have the power to shape California’s future like never before.
The November 4th statewide special election is our opportunity to do something. We’ve seen the harm the Trump administration has inflicted on our communities across California, from targeting Latino families with cruel immigration policies to rolling back opportunities for young people. These attacks have gone unchecked since day one because MAGA Republicans control every branch of government and continue to enable Trump.
Prop 50 is our chance to fight back. It's how we protect our families, our future, and the community that raised us. When everything is on the line, we have to show up. This is it. We must pass Prop 50.

# Gold smashes yesterdays record, now up 55% as the "Debasement Trade" heats up
Gold futures shattered records again Wednesday, surging past $4,060 an ounce as **[investors fled to safe-haven assets](https://substack.com/redirect/13b4386c-4e8f-4ff7-9a84-0a97f0013de1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** amid Japan's fiscal stimulus pivot and a weakening U.S. dollar, fueling parallel rallies in silver and bitcoin.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/13b4386c-4e8f-4ff7-9a84-0a97f0013de1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Gold Futures Shatter Records** : Spot gold climbed $55 per ounce in a single day, meaning that Gold is now up 55% year-to-date, driven by ETF inflows and central bank demand amid currency debasement fears.
* **Gold Surges Amid Dollar Woes** : Gold has climbed more than 20% since late July fueled by the U.S. dollar's sharpest annual drop against major currencies since the 1970s post-gold standard era.
* **Silver Reaches Decade Peak** : Silver futures climbed to $48.70 per ounce, surging 65% this year, as lower interest rates enhance appeal of non-yielding precious metals.
* **Bitcoin Nears All-Time High** : BTC traded around $123,000, just shy of $126,160 record, benefiting from fiscal uncertainty and weakening dollar trends.
* **Japan 's Stimulus Sparks Rally**: New PM Sanae Takaichi's "fiscal dove" stance signals deficit-driven growth, boosting the "debasement trade" with equities also hitting highs.
* **Jewelry Prices Hiked:** Affordable jewelry brands like Mejuri and Pandora have been **[forced to hike prices and scramble for alternatives](https://substack.com/redirect/52c1bd48-599d-4935-9bfc-83840bf2c8ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to shield profit margins from the relentless surge.
* **Midsize Brands Adapt Tactics** : Companies like Pandora face 80-basis-point cost hits while Signet grapples with 30%+ gold expense jumps, prompting supply chain tweaks and lower-karat innovations to stay viable.
* **Analysts Predict Prolonged Rally** : Goldman Sachs eyes 6% more gains to mid-2026, with 95% of central banks planning higher holdings, signaling persistent uncertainty.

# **Bank of England sees a rough future if the AI bubble pops**
The Bank of England issued a stark alert Wednesday, cautioning that a bursting artificial intelligence bubble **[could unleash a"sharp market correction,"](https://substack.com/redirect/259637e2-5d7c-4ef5-9a22-3dd1dcbbc73b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** hammering global equities and rippling through the U.K.'s open economy amid already strained households and businesses.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/259637e2-5d7c-4ef5-9a22-3dd1dcbbc73b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Valuations Hit Record Highs** : Equity markets perch at near all-time peaks, propelled by robust U.S. tech earnings, rendering them vulnerable to AI-driven downside shocks.
* **S &P Concentration Peaks Historically**: Top five S&P 500 firms command nearly 30% market share, the highest in 50 years, amplifying risks from AI hype reversal.
* **AI Progress Risks Emerge** : Disappointing adoption, fierce competition, or supply bottlenecks in power, data, and commodities could swiftly deflate lofty earnings expectations.
* **Global Tensions Amplify Threats** : Geopolitical strife, trade fragmentation, and political uncertainties in France, Japan, and the U.S. heighten chances of unpriced adverse outcomes.

# Goldman Sachs: No Bubble Burst......YET!
Goldman Sachs' top equity strategist Peter Oppenheimer warns the U.S. stock market's **[AI-fueled surge echoes past bubbles](https://substack.com/redirect/28bc5374-816a-43c1-8107-810391f5aeb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with soaring tech valuations and narrowing leadership, but robust fundamentals keep it from bursting--for now.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/28bc5374-816a-43c1-8107-810391f5aeb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Valuations Echo Past Bubbles** : Oppenheimer notes similarities like climbing P/E ratios and AI vendor financing reminiscent of the 1990s dot-com era, yet current levels remain below historical extremes.
* **Tech Giants Dominate Globally** : The five largest U.S. tech firms now outvalue entire markets of Europe, UK, India, Japan, and Canada combined, with top 10 stocks claiming 24.5% of worldwide equities.
* **Fundamentals Anchor Rally** : Unlike speculative booms, today's leaders like Nvidia and Microsoft boast strong balance sheets and aligned cash flows, supporting sustainable growth over irrational hype.
* **Risks Loom on Horizon** : Stretched tech metrics however do signal caution; intensified competition or weakening earnings could tip the market into bubble territory, with analysts urging vigilant monitoring.

# 7-11 to embrace a revamp of its stores after 45% jump in sales during tests
In a bold pivot to revive its fading U.S. empire, 7-Eleven--under Japanese parent Seven & i Holdings--is slashing underperforming outlets and flooding shelves with fan-favorite egg-salad sandwiches and healthier eats, **[fueling 45% sales surges](https://substack.com/redirect/5a4b27c6-0be4-4613-b3ef-58d21b932fe2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in revamped spots amid a rejected $47 billion takeover.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5a4b27c6-0be4-4613-b3ef-58d21b932fe2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Overhaul Sparks Sales Surge** : Revamped U.S. stores achieve 45% higher sales per location, proving early success in food-focused redesigns amid 17% net income drop last year.
* **IPO Looms on Horizon** : Seven & i Holdings is eyeing a planned 2026 public spin-off of its North American arm, retaining a majority stake while trying to boost profitability in its revenue-heavy yet low-margin U.S. operations. Canadian chain Couche-Tard's which owns the Circle K brand scrapped a $47 billion acquisition in July 2025.
* **Expansion Targets Diners** : Plans for 1,300 new large-format stores by 2030 integrate acquired taco and chicken chains, evolving from complacency to meet shifting consumer tastes.

* * *
* * *
# Homebuyers gamble on risky mortgages amid rate crunch
In a high-stakes bid for affordability, U.S. homebuyers and refinancers are surging **[toward adjustable-rate mortgages,](https://substack.com/redirect/d2602ca8-daaf-4b32-8066-67c05b8c51b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with the share of mortgages using them jumping to 9.5% last week as fixed rate mortgages hover stubbornly near 6.43%, according to the Mortgage Bankers Association--despite the looming threat of future rate hikes amid economic uncertainty.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d2602ca8-daaf-4b32-8066-67c05b8c51b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Demand Plunges Overall** : Total mortgage applications fell 4.7% last week on the seasonally adjusted index, reflecting broader market chill from elevated home prices and steady high rates.
* **Refinance Activity Volatile** : Refinancing dropped 8% weekly but remains 18% above last year's levels, buoyed by slight rate dips, while purchase apps edged down 1% yet rose 14% year-over-year.
* **ARM Rates Tempt Savings** : Adjustable mortgages average nearly one percentage point below 30-year fixed options, which has been fueling the shift despite the fixed term on an ARM often lasting only up to 10 years before potential adjustments.
* **Market Signals Caution** : Experts warn of ARM risks as rates could spike post-fixed period. ARM mortgages were one of the contributing factors to the 2008 housing crash and the resulting Great Recession.

subject: Charlie built the machine Let’s make him proud

body:
When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn’t famous.

| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zggjurdjnavg7nk2nv23b98t1dhnt7rgfolg6i9g_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62o32c1h2bs)
---
Friend, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, _" You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois."_ So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving.
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zjhv7eklhdqi8r4gm3ant1uk9depplu0mpuo4jig_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62o32c1h2bs)
---
_**Above:** The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. _
---
Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... _I knew._ Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. >From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. **Faith, family, freedom** -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? _He did it._ He didn't just build a brand... _He built a machine._ First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it _from the start._ Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together.
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zs9mufa1cspi657pr7t6iu8ahl5mqsoccr7f92bg_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62o32c1h2bs)
---
We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us...We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. **And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. ** We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- _and it delivered real results._ 10 for 10. **In every single state we operated in... Trump won.** In Arizona _alone,_ we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. _In Wisconsin?_ 60,000+. _In Nevada?_ 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. _In Michigan?_ 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... _We made history. _
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zk0vvf53ihq84vblr8jtug3j225ajcmn203ubbj8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62o32c1h2bs)
---
_**Above:** Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _
---
Friend, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _ He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? **We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- ****_and make it stronger than ever._** Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- _we must turn it into action._ He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: _" What are we building next?"_ **Well, Friend, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time.**
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2ze7da9e16mt7js0k2m57j3nq3lb6gqlqamtk7ado_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62o32c1h2bs)
---
**But it doesn 't happen without you.** _So, here 's my ask..._ Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie.Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie.Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted.I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work.
---
**For Charlie.** **God Bless,** **Tyler Bowyer**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point Action
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z33hn665icp6rdfleupf009k2qs5j2qp7sek568o_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62o32c1h2bs)
---

But he left us with something powerful -- a machine that works... a machine that's proven and battle-tested. Now it's time to run it -- _and run it like never before._ Bigger. Bolder. More battlegrounds. More victories. **Because right now, thanks to a generous supporter of Turning Point Action, your gift will be matched dollar-for-dollar -- up to $500,000, through October 31.** That means, with your gift today: ✅ 2X the activists trained
✅ 2X the voters registered
✅ 2X the pressure on weak-kneed politicians
✅ 2X the ballot-chasing operations
✅ 2X the grassroots strength the Left can't stop We don't need to reinvent anything. Charlie already drew the blueprint and turned the key. So, if you've been wondering how to help... If you've been asking _" what now?"_ **Then, Friend, this is your moment to step in, fuel the fight, and take Charlie 's vision to the next level.** Let's turn this energy -- this momentum -- into action. **[Let's deliver America First victories in every corner of this country. And many more for years to come. Make your gift to Turning Point Action today and immediately double your impact.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zonhmv8djq7v9ou7eplfb5dogu0f04kfeci0juoo_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62o32c1h2bs)**

name: Tyler Bowyer, Turning Point Action
subject: Charlie built the machine Let’s make him proud
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TURNING POINT ACTION (TPACTION
body:
When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn’t famous.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zaqegj92jg698at1fhi3ub587ve0nrssh75bk35o_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62p72c9h2bs)
---
Friend, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, _" You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois."_ So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zelfeeusveemc9ffga0j46veud6msjpeudm4h08o_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62p72c9h2bs)
---
_**Above:** The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. _
---
Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... _I knew._ Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. **Faith, family, freedom** -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? _He did it._ He didn't just build a brand... _He built a machine._ First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it _from the start._ Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmtq3aovs08eg5o6o94j6lju3ttgmm6rdnpccva8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62p72c9h2bs)
---
We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us...We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. **And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. ** We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- _and it delivered real results._ 10 for 10. **In every single state we operated in... Trump won.** In Arizona _alone,_ we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. _In Wisconsin?_ 60,000+. _In Nevada?_ 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. _In Michigan?_ 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... _We made history. _
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfjdt4hevnnkm5sucrcmgiqmsubj6hk3jf8lipk0_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62p72c9h2bs)
---
_**Above:** Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _
---
Friend, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _ He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? **We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- ****_and make it stronger than ever._** Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- _we must turn it into action._ He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: _" What are we building next?"_ **Well, Friend, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time.**
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zspijnaetu1k6updei09nrkcntap0jbgui8ttbq8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1g62p72c9h2bs)
---
**But it doesn 't happen without you.** _So, here 's my ask..._ Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie.Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie.Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted.I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work.
---
**For Charlie.** **God Bless,** **Tyler Bowyer**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point Action

A few people told me, " You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois." So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving. Above: The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... I knew. Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. name: Robert Dewey
subject: Starting now, you’re a wildlife defender
body:
There are many ways you can protect the animals you love, starting right now! Dear Defender,

A better world for wildlife doesn’t just happen – it needs to be created by
dedicated and compassionate wildlife advocates like you!

We’re so glad to have you on our side. These are tough times for the animals you
and I love, but by raising our voices together we can keep them safe.

Want to start helping right away? You can speak up to defend the Endangered
Species Act and all the animals it protects by signing a quick message to your legislators!
[https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10063/4070964?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=U7jHqDhqVXcqJI2ZMf1z3w==]

Together, our community of Wildlife Defenders makes a true, lasting impact for
wildlife in many ways:

* Dedicated advocates like you held the line and helped achieve a landmark victory in protecting the Okefenokee National Wildlife Refuge and
its animals from destruction by mining corporations!
[https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10063/3901605?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=U7jHqDhqVXcqJI2ZMf1z3w==]
* We speak up to protect millions of acres of habitat for vulnerable wildlife,
including crucial habitat for imperiled polar bears in Alaska!
[https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10063/3901606?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=U7jHqDhqVXcqJI2ZMf1z3w==]
* Our members meet with elected officials in Congress and beyond to share
personal stories, advocate for strong policies to protect our planet, and
much more!

As Defenders' Vice President of Government Relations, I have the privilege of
working with our amazing team of dedicated field staff on the front lines of
wildlife protection. Our work is possible because of passionate, outspoken
advocates like you who form the backbone of the Defenders community.

Defenders provides you with tools to create real change, from exclusive
trainings and issue briefings to opportunities to represent your community in
wildlife advocacy. You’ll hear from us with chances to raise your voice for
wildlife during critical moments.

I look forward to sharing stories of the victories you’re making possible on
behalf of wildlife for years to come.

With my thanks,

Robert Dewey

Vice President, Government Relations
Defenders of Wildlife

P.S.: We want to keep you up-to-date on breaking wildlife stories and actions as
they happen. Make sure you don’t miss a thing: Please add our email address to your favorites, and if this email arrived in
your promotions tab, please move this message to your main inbox, too!

[http://www.facebook.com/DefendersofWildlife] [http://twitter.com/defenders] [https://www.instagram.com/defendersofwildlife/?hl=en] [http://www.youtube.com/defendersofwildlife] [https://www.tiktok.com/@defendersofwildlife]

Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 defenders.org [https://defenders.org]

When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous.

| | | [](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckTGvnDAMxz9N2DglTggwMFQ9IXV4b-0YGcd3REeAJuFO_fYV7Q2d32bZ_59_svzzw31gWMJ6_8TIAz2DS9m9Zl7DLaRcIheaMS2Bw2PllwMJTa1kLXu3py3vTMWpyg_krYaKB9VaKaVRoKp5AMNqkr6bDOqmsdCC1l0n_Y0MUT_ZKgznPiVlr6SUur80VrG12HRktbdSCiOP3WPhfKFtzZyeWMKTw7puZ7WtF9pitQxzKXsW-puAUcCYmY7EF1zZb-VMCBjLjnQCAsZWmwmsaetOc1ObtuW6v7GqveqAzW0ywCD0mLcjETvaPAt9_f7jswWjrAB7lOgi-yMKfeWIYXn3_gFCX2dMHvPDIf16jwjjjuG-Cn2lh1v4jvTbRSw0vwOFU_zPUqXB76-wLCHbVhh5PzV_by1f_dFzgD8BAAD__1GYoPQ)
---
Friend, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, _" You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois."_ So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving.
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckTGvnDAMxz9N2DglTggwMFQ9IXV4b-0YGcd3REeAJuFO_fYV7Q2d32bZ_59_svzzw31gWMJ6_8TIAz2DS9m9Zl7DLaRcIheaMS2Bw2PllwMJTa1kLXu3py3vTMWpyg_krYaKB9VaKaVRoKp5AMNqkr6bDOqmsdCC1l0n_Y0MUT_ZKgznPiVlr6SUur80VrG12HRktbdSCiOP3WPhfKFtzZyeWMKTw7puZ7WtF9pitQxzKXsW-puAUcCYmY7EF1zZb-VMCBjLjnQCAsZWmwmsaetOc1ObtuW6v7GqveqAzW0ywCD0mLcjETvaPAt9_f7jswWjrAB7lOgi-yMKfeWIYXn3_gFCX2dMHvPDIf16jwjjjuG-Cn2lh1v4jvTbRSw0vwOFU_zPUqXB76-wLCHbVhh5PzV_by1f_dFzgD8BAAD__1GYoPQ)
---
_**Above:** The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. _
---
Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... _I knew._ Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. **Faith, family, freedom** -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? _He did it._ He didn't just build a brand... _He built a machine._ First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it _from the start._ Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together.
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckTGvnDAMxz9N2DglTggwMFQ9IXV4b-0YGcd3REeAJuFO_fYV7Q2d32bZ_59_svzzw31gWMJ6_8TIAz2DS9m9Zl7DLaRcIheaMS2Bw2PllwMJTa1kLXu3py3vTMWpyg_krYaKB9VaKaVRoKp5AMNqkr6bDOqmsdCC1l0n_Y0MUT_ZKgznPiVlr6SUur80VrG12HRktbdSCiOP3WPhfKFtzZyeWMKTw7puZ7WtF9pitQxzKXsW-puAUcCYmY7EF1zZb-VMCBjLjnQCAsZWmwmsaetOc1ObtuW6v7GqveqAzW0ywCD0mLcjETvaPAt9_f7jswWjrAB7lOgi-yMKfeWIYXn3_gFCX2dMHvPDIf16jwjjjuG-Cn2lh1v4jvTbRSw0vwOFU_zPUqXB76-wLCHbVhh5PzV_by1f_dFzgD8BAAD__1GYoPQ)
---
We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. **And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. ** We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- _and it delivered real results._ 10 for 10. **In every single state we operated in... Trump won.** In Arizona _alone,_ we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. _In Wisconsin?_ 60,000+. _In Nevada?_ 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. _In Michigan?_ 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... _We made history. _
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckTGvnDAMxz9N2DglTggwMFQ9IXV4b-0YGcd3REeAJuFO_fYV7Q2d32bZ_59_svzzw31gWMJ6_8TIAz2DS9m9Zl7DLaRcIheaMS2Bw2PllwMJTa1kLXu3py3vTMWpyg_krYaKB9VaKaVRoKp5AMNqkr6bDOqmsdCC1l0n_Y0MUT_ZKgznPiVlr6SUur80VrG12HRktbdSCiOP3WPhfKFtzZyeWMKTw7puZ7WtF9pitQxzKXsW-puAUcCYmY7EF1zZb-VMCBjLjnQCAsZWmwmsaetOc1ObtuW6v7GqveqAzW0ywCD0mLcjETvaPAt9_f7jswWjrAB7lOgi-yMKfeWIYXn3_gFCX2dMHvPDIf16jwjjjuG-Cn2lh1v4jvTbRSw0vwOFU_zPUqXB76-wLCHbVhh5PzV_by1f_dFzgD8BAAD__1GYoPQ)
---
_**Above:** Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _
---
Friend, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _ He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? **We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- ****_and make it stronger than ever._** Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- _we must turn it into action._ He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: _" What are we building next?"_ **Well, Friend, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time.**
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckTGvnDAMxz9N2DglTggwMFQ9IXV4b-0YGcd3REeAJuFO_fYV7Q2d32bZ_59_svzzw31gWMJ6_8TIAz2DS9m9Zl7DLaRcIheaMS2Bw2PllwMJTa1kLXu3py3vTMWpyg_krYaKB9VaKaVRoKp5AMNqkr6bDOqmsdCC1l0n_Y0MUT_ZKgznPiVlr6SUur80VrG12HRktbdSCiOP3WPhfKFtzZyeWMKTw7puZ7WtF9pitQxzKXsW-puAUcCYmY7EF1zZb-VMCBjLjnQCAsZWmwmsaetOc1ObtuW6v7GqveqAzW0ywCD0mLcjETvaPAt9_f7jswWjrAB7lOgi-yMKfeWIYXn3_gFCX2dMHvPDIf16jwjjjuG-Cn2lh1v4jvTbRSw0vwOFU_zPUqXB76-wLCHbVhh5PzV_by1f_dFzgD8BAAD__1GYoPQ)
---
**But it doesn 't happen without you.** _So, here 's my ask..._ Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie. Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie. Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work.
---
**For Charlie.** **God Bless,** **Tyler Bowyer**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point Action

## Trump Announces Gaza Agreement
President Trump announced Wednesday that Israel and Hamas had [reached the first phase of a ceasefire deal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDtu6zAQAE9DdTKWpD5PBYvXqHPalMKGWlobrEiBpG3Ipw-cK6QeYAaYz-tyRRaOtw_cydWQlkjPIlQr5eWGL1wJxaedznIIIcYVd3wtBkzfamhhWlZkOZeuWV0gMmQbcnocAKDTBprNDX7tSXcB_4V-xFHbzqL3ZAHCMAXrG3ZvmwaYNIDup8vXRP1oyYKfMAxgVQe0ck358p041o2CnOlB-eLT3ojbaj2Ksv-VmZWZ60Ybi7yZMvORhP2pzMyxUo5YOUUUZea-7wajbVvzfT9ajDHdo6fScslI0m64Y2k9YaHAmZSZm-zW48kiXIZRdXDbkX8rTf3TtoczPwEAAP__uAeCOQ), paving the way for the release of 20 living hostages and a pause in fighting in the Gaza Strip. The deal calls for [Israel to partially withdraw](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkM1qwzAQhJ9GvtmsVv6pDzqkFN_SHlro0WysVawiW0ZWYpKnL-or9DYwMMz3fZ_HMznv1us7LayTDePKx-45JY7jlZ5kmPwUFn7sm2ei1dBCzxEBm1JCCf1oyPnHWBdGW2ZkVbCWXQsAtUQoZn2hF8mgJJO1prVYY9vZS9dLAw0ZRYXTeU0C9BJANn116bnpFCuYerItKFEDG5dCrH6CW9PM1j_CnWM1haXwek5p24U6CRwEDsdxVMu-5k7gwGt52wUOGUrgsAXvkptyzGxlhisj0zSzKVO8LZvAgWJ5OsmP9iugUEOYnBHq7TUr4mP_5LgVUZvtcN67ve1EDdeFnP87k_5l8K7xNwAA___nXoT7) from Gaza and for Hamas to begin releasing hostages, according to Trump. The president described the agreement on Truth Social "_as the first steps toward a Strong, Durable, and Everlasting Peace. All Parties will be treated fairly!”_ Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu issued a statement minutes later. _“With God’s help, we will bring them all home,_ ” he said, referring to the remaining living captives. Hamas also holds the bodies of 28 dead hostages.
## Nor'easter to Bring Coastal Flood Threat
A major [nor'easter is forecast to develop](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb0QPsB0zMHTxlq4drRfzbFNhXgQoVvL1VVq1P9D56l7dcz4u0wVDDGl9x51cXXhKdJRItVKeVnyiJ4wz7_Qot0iIyeOOz0mD7qQCCXbyGOJjahvvFiJNpiGnzj0AtEpDszlqW7BmIOtbgn5AA1fT2UUNMGilCJvgXmsKwCoA1dnT1VJ3NmRgtrj0YEQL5EPlfPrkkOpGS3zwnfJp5r2Jbqv1VoR5E3oUejwI6_aTCT0unGnGUoUeM62BE0ahxxei0OMfxCATZ8JSKcuZsVSMslTOu_ztyyMkL5fI7ENaJc-Vr5Sb7PztCDGG0p9FC-uOIX6_qv9SeXf6KwAA___3yYiP) off the East Coast this weekend, likely lasting through Monday at least and bringing the threat of strong winds, heavy rain, and coastal flooding from the Carolinas to Southern New England. The highest risk for [strong winds and subsequent power outages](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykUD1vgzAQ_TWwgc42EDx46JItXTuiwz4HVwZH5hSX_PqK5id0fE9P7-vrNt0wxLDdP3Elwz5NG5U9EjPl6Y4vdITRppWO_REJcXO44muSIPtGQAN6chjiMXW1M55IkqrJiMsAAJ2QUC9GYTfL0QoxqFFaLXurZj33diTr-tH5OpjTTQBoASB63c6a-osiBVajH0BVHZALnHL7ncLGC_l4pCfl1qa1jmZhfuyV-qjktZLXUkrr008h5OUtOck3as5tlbxuKRPuTLnhJRNykyynmXJzFqmzcY8SYgz7cKk6uK8Y4l8U_-ufp5G_AQAA__-lI3qn) is forecast from the Outer Banks of North Carolina to Long Island. While the heaviest rainfall is currently predicted from the eastern Carolinas to southern New Jersey, the overall track of the low-pressure center remains tricky. Although the storm is not tropical in origin, there is a low chance it could linger over the warm Gulf Stream waters and morph into a named subtropical storm, which [would be called Karen](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O5CAUhE-DM6wH_g8INnHWm25oPcOzzQqDBbhR9-lHPXOESSoolUqfvn-P5YHWWb__xZNU3sLiqSRHOVNcdnyjIXQ6nPRKlyNEb_DE9yJBdlwAh2kxaN1raSujNiJJTUVKDD0AtEJCdSgczNojrlKuBGIEMbYTtDTKtR_Xdugqqz5vAmASAKKb6nWibmioAT3h1kPDWiBjc4j1_2B9Pmhzr_CkWOtwVk4dOV-JNX-YnJmcSyk1an0Xwnz8bJicyTM5H3eMVqMnJueUY_A7zzFcVqPjPkTClCnyHPiB50mR34l_Oq7DJ4vNB99cCMb6nRfrDUdvOMWQ7JN4uuPG5CxG2QwwVFGZq1jnbOoH1sJ-onXfvPlXkp9KfgUAAP__6ZiTIg).
## Man Charged In Deadly Palisades Fire
Federal authorities on Wednesday charged Jonathan Rinderknecht, a 29-year-old Uber driver living in Florida, with [maliciously setting the Palisades Fire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2u3CAQBeCnwR2rYfyzcUGRhu6mTWnNhWGXCIPFsHfl-_SR8wqpj_TpnPP7Y_uglFN5_KKdbY91K_yWzL1z2x70TYEp-7rzKUdmohJop-8NAWdtQMO6BUr53KYh2MiMPA5szX0BgMkgDE-7LD7iSLgsCwWKdxwpTMbH2U_h08zjkOylGYDVAJh5vX2uPN9HHsGvFBcY1QQcUq_t9qem0p8c81m_uN183Ydsn70fosafCp1CV86jSr8ihe6CFToDCh38UOheoq99Cp285GDfdSo6MIV86lxFU3lwZtEH5SQUWHRMjTW1xtI56ExvzSXW5nnn0rXUV_MsWuhU6IZmw_FOOSdZ7mqCx04p_2vZ_-vaL4t_AwAA___-Qo5X) nine months after the blaze caused 12 deaths and an estimated $150 billion in damages in Los Angeles. Rinderknecht allegedly set a brush fire on Jan. 1, 2025, near a popular hiking trail, which then smoldered for days before igniting the larger, devastating inferno that destroyed more than 6,000 homes. [Evidence against the suspect](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1urDAQxfGngQ40_gCuCxe3odu0KdGsPcBExka2s2j36aPNK6Q-R7_i_3lbbsiB4_aBB9m6piXSVQLVSnnZ8IWeMLh00LOcgRCjxwNfiwQ5dAI6MItHDs9Ft96uRJJUS1ZMIwBoIaHdLZh_ahDojdD3u3BGrgKVH1GvekJJrmX71gSAEQBiMP3d0DApUuAMriOoRgN5rin3X4lj3WkNz_Sg3Lt0tMHutZ6lUf8bOTdyvq6rxxTeWyNnzJVdoNLI-cDYYc5UKvmufJeTHafYlfr-xK070fHKrhMjTNrAoPq9HqHN1p8Xh8BlnBoN24H8i7f1T7UeVv4EAAD__wbkfsA) includes his searching ChatGPT about cigarette-sparked fires, as well as his phone containing videos of the fire and a prior AI-generated image of a dystopian burning city. Rinderknecht, who was arrested in Florida, had no prior criminal history and is being transferred to California to face charges of malicious destruction by means of fire.

If Democrats lose control of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court this November, we don't just lose one election -- we lose the rules of the game for every election that follows.

## Paxton Investigating 'Leftist Terror Cells'
Attorney General Ken Paxton is [launching an initiative](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDtygzAQhk8DnZjVA2EKFWnonDYls0iL0VgGRtoYfPuMfYX0_2O-7-c6XjGmuN6-8UGOz3kbVzpKImbKY2sAAH2mwsi0Y74z-aWsNCpQrZAgoB8DxvQaTR3cBKGXNTnZWQDobG_qxWkpJYGRMBPp6dK19mJbq-ykvLa-13V07zEJ0EsJUutGGzQthBbbIANNtjJAIfKWG16I6cQyp9f2pNz47VEntzDvpdJflRoqNRzH0czb2eFv4bi-I5Ua3kyVGj5lsePJ2yoSzRwLC6actyw8pVSEXzCnSOIe810ETAmLiJ7q7MJ-xJRisV1l4PbAmD73_D9pT6f-AgAA__-IRYDa) to "infiltrate and uproot leftist terror cells" in Texas in response to the assassination of Charlie Kirk and "the disturbing rise of leftist violence across the country." Paxton [cited recent attacks](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZB61jYGbwMEkZHuXnHQh6sVtsNbYyG6G2b8_Mb-wWZVKeqqqfx_TB4YY0vIbN7L88nlKdNZIzFSmzgAAzoUqI9OO5YtpXmuiSYPupAIJ98lhiN-TaZz9BHdXDVk19AAw9HfTrLa9XOe879SswKveD27wRuMv0EAwN8FeMAVwVwpU295ag6YD12HnlKPPXhggFziXG6_E9MLq43d-UrnNeWuiXZn3KtqH0KPQ43met62mKxN6pCSPKvR4jRJ6fOsvSnLHF-ckMaV8pJmqPJKjMl9UGdKTKocFOeQkQ-IsMXHwKJeSj_1CYJGPh_qj619qinX7GWIMtR-EgWXDEN_N-Gd_Pq3-HwAA__-xvooJ) on ICE facilities in Alvarado and Dallas in announcing the undercover operations. He also mentioned President Trump's designation of Antifa as a domestic terrorist organization. According to federal authorities, Antifa and anarchist ideologies [motivated](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ_GdEZrY0MoXFxDl2uvRIu9AScORPYmJG9_ItL_BH87o_k0M__O4xljiuv8F-_k-H3ZxpX2koiZ8mgNAKDPVBiZHphvTH4pK40atJUKJPRjwJg-o6mCmyD0qiKnuhYAurY31eL8STWTDS0G1GCNp06bvievfLCnyUIV3QFTAL1SoJqmbgwaC8GiDSrQ1AoDFCJvueaFmN5YLumzvSjXfrtXyS3MjyKaP0IPQg_7vtd-KseKwxd6-EaEHg5J6OFCgTImeX2GmWShNRQZPUlkRn-THgtJ3uSccQ3y-swf-QOosguPPaYUS9sJA_MdY_qW4N9d93L6fwAAAP__AhyCvA) more than a dozen armed militants who opened fire on Alvarado's ICE facility on July 4. One officer was briefly hospitalized after being struck in the neck. "_Leftist political terrorism is a clear and present danger_ ," [Paxton said in a statement](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OozAQxp8GOqOxY_BSuLgm3V57JRrwBKx1bDSehOTtT6zunmC7r_jp-_fnc_rEmGJef-OdvLxuZcp01EQixFNvAQAXpiootCN_CS1bzTQZML3SoGCcAsb0nmwb_Axh1C157QYAcMNo281bPQ7WjsO4zEsIH46cQzNr0zsXPvQc2uhPMw0wag36cukuFm0Pocc-6EDz0FigEKVwJxsJvbDe0rs8ibul3NvkN5G9Npdfjbk25nocR_cNoUjhTO-VMjGmbi3PxlzPdY25MiXCSqf8z6l_oPqirHZ8Sckq4SMvG1X1yIF4OUNV2YlRYslVxXyLSRiFFOagHjuXIirRTWIVJcRcuGUf9iOmFOvgGgvrHWP6bi4_-_vpzd8AAAD__04VmXY). "_To those demented souls who seek to kill, steal, and destroy our country, know this: you cannot hide, you cannot escape, and justice is coming_."
## Rio Grande Bridge Transferred to Cameron County
The Brownsville and Matamoros International Bridge is [now jointly owned](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGuozAQheGngc7R2BgIhYtt6O62W6LBnoTRGpu1J8nl7VfJK9z-09HR_-dr-UKOnO6_cScn37e8JHrVSCJUlt4CAPpCVVDowPJXyG810WLA9EqDgmkJyPFcbBvcCmHSLTk9DgAwDpNtN-d1p_uxB3P1ttN-HSz6gaw1_nqdzEQtu_eYBpi0Bt11l86i7SH02AcdaB0aCxRYcrnIRkLfWG_xzE8qF5_3NrpN5KhN96sxc2PmD1hzCVTWR-VEtb5dY2aPO5WclM-PJGdVG1fJhb1C_-_BlYVzUvmm1pJfqT45RlI7Cu655KrWwuFOyuf9wHQ2Zm6LC8eLY-Q6jI2F-44cP5fkZyGfzvwPAAD__zhBiek) by Cameron County and Mexico, following commissioners' unanimous approval of an agreement to purchase Union Pacific Railroad's 50% ownership stake. The oldest of four Cameron County bridges spanning the Rio Grande, Congress [authorized its construction](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCnMZ3R2tjwU7i4hi7XXokWvAnWGRvZmxDe_pS8wvWjTzPz5zbfMMSQHr9xJ8fve54TnTUSM5XZGgDAtVBlZDqw_GVat5po1qCtVCBhnD2GeM2m8W4BP6qGnBp6ABj60TSbU8OqRk-WfnDUhqwxHofF9n4BZXzfNcF9MAUwKgWq69rOoLHgLVqvPC29MEA-cC4tb8T0xnqPV35Rade8N9FtzEcV3S-hJ6Gn8zzb_aqYMHFOIX9CQk-fVUJPNT95k19E6AkLhzWS0NNS8pnqK8RIckfGPZdc5VKCf5BccaeSk1zzM_EltYIf6IehPbajKc4fZ4gx1H4QBh47hvjtxf_35svpfwEAAP__RgiJvw) in 1909 as a joint project of the St. Louis, Brownsville and Mexico Railway and the Mexican National Railway. A second bridge for auto and foot traffic was constructed immediately adjacent to the original in 1997. A Cameron County attorney hailed the agreement as "the only transaction of its kind in American history." It's unclear how much the county has agreed to pay Union Pacific for its stake. Next year, parts of the nearby Gateway International Bridge will be shut down as it undergoes a $264 million expansion project to double its capacity. Traffic at the B&M Bridge is [expected to increase](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1ygzAQBOCnER3MSQgIhYo06pw2JXOSzkYT8RPpbMzbZ5w8Qvqd_Wb38zJdMKa43j5wIcPP6zatdJREzJSnTgMA-kyFkWnH_MXk57LSpEB1tYQaxilgTOekq2AchFFWZOTQA8DQj7qajcOgFfrQOUJUg_RyDDi6Hgnbtz50VTSvMgkwSgmybZtWo-4gdNgFGcj1QgOFyFtueCamJ5ZrOrcH5cZvS5XMzLwX0b4LZYWyx3E0xb1G7Lj_ZYSyL0IoK0EoC61Q1m_3lc8a_fc9Ziq1yzHcqPbbsuN6CmWrbMJ-xJRi6Qeh4bZgTL8i_--nh1E_AQAA__9annrR) during the construction period.
## 54,000-Acre State Park Proposed
The Texas Parks and Wildlife Department plans to acquire a 54,000-acre property in Kinney and Edwards counties to [create a new state park](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uszAMQJ8GNpCdHwhDhm_p1m-9I3KJKdFNAQWrad_-iuq-wd2ObOlYx1_X8UoxxfX-nx7s5TVv48rlSCzCebQGAGjKfAgJ75S_haflWHlUoGyD0MAwBorpPZo6-BuEAWv22HcA0HeDqRc_W62CI1YWFDq8aQd970g7M8FsO6yjP2UIMCACat1qQ8ZCsGQDBr51lQEOUbbcysLCLzrm9N6enNtpe9TJLyL7Uel_lbpU6lJKaaclb-u5rdQlxZnPcUzhFylLnNJJK5fmI2w-gc1Z2CgEN6B27b7sdfZhLzGleHR9ZeD-oJg-Z-Vvz3p69RMAAP__RoJ7NQ). Owned by the Moody family of Galveston, the Silver Lake Ranch could be the largest addition to the state park system since the 1980s. body:
Did you miss this?
| **THIS IS AN AUTOMATED MESSAGE:**

We’re reaching out to Democrats who have **not added their signature** to our time-sensitive letter to Supreme Court Justice Sotomayor, _following her BLISTERING dissent against the MAGA-majority court._

**Justice Sonia Sotomayor is leading the charge against Trump’s authoritarian administration. We need to make sure Democrats in your state are standing _firmly behind her_ in this fight!**

We’re sending our letter tonight at 9pm, and reaching out **ONE FINAL TIME** and [**asking you to add your signature to our letter to stand with Justice Sotomayor as she takes on Trump and his far-right administration! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94511?t=6&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ) | [**Donate $3 to sign the letter now »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94511?t=7&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ)
---
Thank you for taking action,
— The Voter Protection Project

**\- - - - - - Begin Forwarded Message - - - - - -**
From: Time Sensitive Letter (via VPP)
To: Top Democrats
Subject: Justice Sotomayor’s STARK Warning >>
_Justice Sotomayor just put the MAGA SCOTUS majority & Donald Trump to SHAME:_
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94511?t=8&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ)
**If a member of the Supreme Court — _who is supposed to be impartial_ — is sounding the alarm, _we should ALL be listening._**

Team, we’re so grateful for Sotomayor’s BRAVE leadership — but Republicans are FURIOUS with Sotomayor, and they’re _plotting revenge._

We need to show Supreme Court Justice Sotomayor that Democrats (especially Democrats in your state) have her back!

[**As one of the FEW protectors of our democracy left on the Supreme Court, we’re sending Sotomayor a letter thanking her for her incredible work. WE HAVE ONLY 18 SPOTS LEFT:**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94511?t=9&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ)
[**Donate $3 to sign the letter now »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94511?t=10&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ)
---
TO: Justice Sonia Sotomayor
FROM: A proud Democrat
Subject: Thank you for taking a stand. **Dear Justice Sotomayor,

Thank you for standing up for our democracy against Donald Trump’s authoritarian agenda and blatant disregard of the Constitution.**

Your bravery continues to blow us away, time after time.

**As Trump tries to seize more and more control from Congress and the courts, your resilience is needed now more than ever.**

I’m sick and tired of the GOP letting him off scot-free — so I’m doing everything in my power to elect Democrats and ensure we appoint more amazing Supreme Court Justices like YOU in the near future.

[**I know you’re facing relentless attacks from Trump and his MAGA minions, so I’m signing this thank you letter and chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to help Democrats keep fighting for justice »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94511?t=11&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ) [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94511?t=12&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ) | [**Donate $3 to sign now »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94511?t=13&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ)
---
**_X A grateful Democrat_**
—The Voter Protection Project
| | Paid for by VPP
(www.protectvoting.org)
Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. 401 2nd Ave. S, Ste. 303, Seattle, WA 98104

The Voter Protection Project is on an important mission: To end partisan gerrymandering and voter suppression by electing candidates at the state and federal levels that are forceful advocates for voting rights. Our enfranchisement agenda includes working to ensure that every state has automatic voter registration and online voter registration, convenient early voting, and independent redistricting commissions to ensure politicians are not able to draw their own maps.

Please, consider making a [one-time contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/121?t=1&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ). **Or, to make the most powerful lasting impact and help us oust Republicans up and down the ballot who attack our right to vote, make a[monthly sustaining contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/122?t=2&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ).**

[Click here](https://act.protectvoting.org/signup/fewer-emails/?t=3&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ) to request fewer emails. Click here to [unsubscribe](https://act.protectvoting.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=14&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ). | | [Please: Pitch In Once A Month To Protect Voting Rights »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/123?t=4&akid=21414%2E878179%2Ex5QVIZ)

**Words Matter!**
Now, more than ever, the words we choose are important--they carry real-world impact. It used to be that the wrong words might cause hurt feelings or make tempers flare. In today's highly charged world, however, careless words can spark anger, violence, murder, and other acts of pure evil.
Like many in today's dark and troubled world, I have been drawn back to the words of faith. My faith is driven by the all powerful message of Jesus the King. He provides so many words that help express the angst of today's weary and wandering world. It is with this backdrop that we are holding a "No King But Jesus" gathering for community prayer and healing.
Together, let's revisit these teachings and ask Jesus to provide our community with the wisdom to use our mouths in a thoughtful and positive way.
> Lord, let the words of our mouths and the thoughts of our hearts be pleasing to You, our Rock and our Redeemer. (Psalm 19:14)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/420f90cf-e212-4d5b-9834-68fc47b507db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I think back to my years as a young attorney. I had a famous Mark Twain quote posted in my office: "The difference between the almost right word and the right word is really a large matter--'tis the difference between the lightning and the lightning bug." I would fret over finding the right word to capture the proper subtleties of meaning. As a society, we need to strive for wisdom in our choice of words and use these expressions to bring about peace and forgiveness.
* Our communities deserve unity, not division;
* Our community morals and laws should be honored and enforced;
* Our spiritual leaders and law enforcement officers shoud be respected and protected;
* We call for "praying for change" over "protesting for change."

Absent the right words, it seems that many good people resort to acts of rage to express themselves. These acts often arise because people feel helpless and alone--their voices unheard. This is the devil's playground: he whispers falsehoods and convinces the lost that dramatic acts will shock the world and force others to hear the "words" they could not speak. Without a belief in eternal damnation, this deception of the enemy offers a false and dangerous tonic of expression.
Following these acts of desperation, we carelessly point the finger--asking, _Who did they vote for?_ _What was their gender identity?_ These words of division and accusation are also whispers of deceit. The devil laughs in glee when we speak in these tongues of confusion, each trying to be understood, yet no one truly hearing the other. Only when we choose to speak with quiet grace - rather than anger and accusation - can we silence the lies and begin to truly hear one another again.
As I reflect on my days spent searching for that dramatic "lightning" phrase to elevate a legal argument, I think again of Jesus--who showed us the power of the Lamb rather than the Lion. Like the image of the Lamb, we can learn from the humble glow of the lightning bug. Simple words, too, carry great power. The challenge is not to speak louder, but to speak with light--with words that build up rather than tear down, that heal rather than wound.
Please join us in seeking those simple words of prayer and reflection. On **Thursday, October 16th at 5:30 p.m.** , we will gather by the mermaid at New Denmark Park in Albert Lea to search for the right words of expression--words of hope, healing, and revival.

clean_body: In a world shouting to be heard, maybe it's time we remember the quiet power of words spoken in truth, love, and light. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more No King but Jesus! Community Prayer for Hope, Healing, and Revival | | | Oct 9 | | | | | | | | | | | | Words Matter! Now, more than ever, the words we choose are important--they carry real-world impact. It used to be that the wrong words might cause hurt feelings or make tempers flare. In today's highly charged world, however, careless words can spark anger, violence, murder, and other acts of pure evil. Like many in today's dark and troubled world, I have been drawn back to the words of faith. My faith is driven by the all powerful message of Jesus the King. He provides so many words that help express the angst of today's weary and wandering world. It is with this backdrop that we are holding a "No King But Jesus" gathering for community prayer and healing. Together, let's revisit these teachings and ask Jesus to provide our community with the wisdom to use our mouths in a thoughtful and positive way. Lord, let the words of our mouths and the thoughts of our hearts be pleasing to You, our Rock and our Redeemer. (Psalm 19:14) | | ---|---|--- I think back to my years as a young attorney. I had a famous Mark Twain quote posted in my office: "The difference between the almost right word and the right word is really a large matter--'tis the difference between the lightning and the lightning bug." I would fret over finding the right word to capture the proper subtleties of meaning. As a society, we need to strive for wisdom in our choice of words and use these expressions to bring about peace and forgiveness. Our communities deserve unity, not division; Our community morals and laws should be honored and enforced; Our spiritual leaders and law enforcement officers shoud be respected and protected; We call for "praying for change" over "protesting for change." Absent the right words, it seems that many good people resort to acts of rage to express themselves. These acts often arise because people feel helpless and alone--their voices unheard. This is the devil's playground: he whispers falsehoods and convinces the lost that dramatic acts will shock the world and force others to hear the "words" they could not speak. Without a belief in eternal damnation, this deception of the enemy offers a false and dangerous tonic of expression. Following these acts of desperation, we carelessly point the finger--asking, Who did they vote for? What was their gender identity? These words of division and accusation are also whispers of deceit. The devil laughs in glee when we speak in these tongues of confusion, each trying to be understood, yet no one truly hearing the other. Only when we choose to speak with quiet grace - rather than anger and accusation - can we silence the lies and begin to truly hear one another again. As I reflect on my days spent searching for that dramatic "lightning" phrase to elevate a legal argument, I think again of Jesus--who showed us the power of the Lamb rather than the Lion. Like the image of the Lamb, we can learn from the humble glow of the lightning bug. Simple words, too, carry great power. The challenge is not to speak louder, but to speak with light--with words that build up rather than tear down, that heal rather than wound. Please join us in seeking those simple words of prayer and reflection. On Thursday, October 16th at 5:30 p.m. , we will gather by the mermaid at New Denmark Park in Albert Lea to search for the right words of expression--words of hope, healing, and revival. | | ---|---|--- You're currently a free subscriber to . Dear Fellow American,

Praise God! The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled, 6-3, in _United States v. Skrmetti_ that states can protect kids from harmful drugs and surgeries. Every child deserves to be kept safe from dangerous procedures.

This is a landmark victory for every child in our country, as the ruling will allow EVERY state to implement similar laws to protect children from the harms of gender ideology.

This win moves us that much closer to finally ending the practice of experimenting on children.
[ DONATE](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zdk2gbmfhang3gco6grh3nu5krca2vhl7l2onu2g_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1j64o74cph2bs)
**Gender ideology is on the ropes.** Now we have to keep the momentum going and finish the job. Several cases and many clients are still waiting for justice from the lies of gender ideology, including:
* **Selina Soule** --she and several other female athletes have been standing up for fairness on and off the field for years. We've beaten back efforts to rewrite Title IX at the federal level, but many states, like Connecticut, continue to push policies that force girls to compete against male athletes.
* **Dan and Jennifer Mead** --their daughter's school secretly treated her as a boy, as part of the school's "social transition" policy. Many school districts around the country still have these policies in place.
* **Brian and Katy Wuoti** --this loving foster couple had their license revoked because they wouldn't agree to push Vermont's radical gender ideology agenda. They are challenging this illegal policy, along with another family.

[With your gift today,](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zqq5f31r8ckcjhhs5sb3thd0ejhsej9tnqjeh0go_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1j64o74cph2bs) we can represent more clients in court (free of charge) and advocate for more good laws that protect children. **Plus, you can help maximize the impact of a special $250,000 challenge grant!**

Thank you for your support. Countless children are now protected from much of gender ideology's irreversible harms.

In Christ,

John Bursch
Senior Counsel, Vice President of Appellate Advocacy
Alliance Defending Freedom

name: Rep. Gloria Johnson
subject: How Can You Help?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF GLORIA JOHNSON, LISA SORENSEN, TREASURER
body:
It's going to take all of us, so here's how you can step up

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/163407cbed87/legislative-wrap-up-7362807?e=dc5f639d62)
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
|
---
| |
Peter

I know it seems like we are living in the upside down right now with all that is happening in Tennessee, our country and around the world. It can get overwhelming, but we can not look away and we must stay involved and push back. They get terrified when we pushback! We know it scares them because they try so hard to prevent our voices from even being heard.
Below is a selection of some of the more significant and recent actions taken by the Trump administration—actions that point toward a worrying concentration of executive power and an erosion of democratic norms.

* Targeted deployment of National Guard troops in cities, and calls to jail elected officials
* Threat to invoke the Insurrection Act and deploy troops to more U.S. cities
* Revival of family separations and aggressive mass deportation tactics
* Education and ideological policing via executive orders
* Attacks on birthright citizenship & constitutional limits
* Assertions of control over independent agencies
* Symbolic and structural moves eroding pluralism and protections

The Trump administration is testing every constitutional boundary—on domestic military deployment, state sovereignty, independent agencies and civil rights enforcement. And just like bullies do, they are all too willing to use brute force. But if you want to stop a bully, you can only do it by standing up to them. Complying in advance only ensures the bullying will continue.

---
[|
---](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=42de6ffbef&e=dc5f639d62)
| |

We see it happening in our own state as troops are being deployed in Memphis, as G.O.P. laws have made it more difficult to legally protest and voice dissent or cast your ballot. Symbolic and cultural expression bans have broader chilling effects beyond the specific case—they send a signal about whose voices are acceptable or safe in public.
Yet everyday I am out in my district or across this state and I am so hopeful because of all the folks out working to make life better for everyone in their community. So that is what I want this email to be about, ways to push back, ways you can actually get out and do something that will effect change.**Here are some ideas on how you can get involved...**

* Today **Representative Justin J. Pearson announced his run for Congress** in West TN. You can find out how to get involved and donate here [https://www.votejustinj.com/](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=29c16389ca&e=dc5f639d62)
* Yesterday,**in TN Congressional District 7, Representative Aftyn Behn won the Democratic Primary in a special election**. If you are in Middle TN, this is a quick turnaround election that needs help now, so find out how you can help here [https://www.aftynforcongress.com/](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=6b15a5427a&e=dc5f639d62)
* **If you care about our immigrant community** and are in the Knoxville area, **AKIN** is an excellent organization to get involved with and you can find them here [https://weareakin.wordpress.com/](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=bfbd608da9&e=dc5f639d62). Statewide, I would suggest TIRRC and you can find out more here [https://www.tnimmigrant.org/](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=c8a262b3fc&e=dc5f639d62).
* If women’s issues are important to you, **The GIRL Institute is putting on a Women’s Equality Summit in Knoxville** with some pretty amazing speakers and panels October 24-26. You can find out more and purchase your tickets here [https://www.thegirlinstitute.org/](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=c2b392a59a&e=dc5f639d62).

[](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=746b66d0a2&e=dc5f639d62)
* **If Education is important to you, SOCM is doing great work** in that area as well as their work in housing justice. You can find out more about them here [https://www.socm.org/](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=5743c8508e&e=dc5f639d62).
* **And don’t forget the No Kings Protest** coming up October 18th, these are all across the state and you can find more info about the one nearest you here [https://www.nokings.org/](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=edd7c322d0&e=dc5f639d62). Indivisible is one group involved in the No Kings protest and is another group you may want to get involved with.
* **TN High School Democrats fundraiser October 12th** at 7008 Sheffield Dr. in Knoxville from 3-5. You can sign up and donate here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tnhsdeasternfundraiser](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=2f656535ec&e=dc5f639d62)[](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=d58cf07451&e=dc5f639d62)
* **Also, don’t forget your local county Democratic Party is always available and working hard for all of us so please join them!**

* As always,**my campaign appreciates your support as well, and donations** are always welcome when you can, and you can do that here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/voteglojo](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=ed142b9df7&e=dc5f639d62).

This is not a full list, but I hope it helps get you started. I think you will find that if you are able to push back even a little, you will be far more hopeful as you join with all our great Tennessee neighbors who care about a multiracial, multigenerational movement. Please don’t forget that taking care of each other and ourselves is important in these times as well. JOY is resistance, so make time for joy in your life as much as you can. Officiating a wedding for a beautiful couple gave me great joy this week!

Much love to you all,
Gloria

| | | | | |
Friend,
We are now nearing a week into the government shutdown, and two things have become abundantly clear. First, Democrats are not interested in bipartisanship or getting things done for the American people. Second, vulnerable Democrats like Senator Chuck Schumer are worried about losing their next election, so they must show their radical base that they are adequately attempting to stop President Trump!
More importantly, the American people must know why their government is shut down. Republicans intended to pass a clean continuing resolution, but radical Democrats insisted that the American people pay for non-citizens to receive healthcare through Medicaid. Democrats are proving that they care more about their left-wing virtue signaling than American citizens! Even worse, they are withholding resources Americans need to provide for themselves and their families.
The longer this shutdown goes, the worse it will get for the innocent Arizonans being used as political pawns in this shutdown. Veterans across our state will have benefits delayed, service members, border patrol, and federal workers may be furloughed or forced to work without pay, and needy families may go hungry.
In Arizona, I have consistently fought for and won balanced budgets, priorities that put Arizona first, and protecting taxpayers – and I will do the same thing in Congress. The American people deserve to know that their representatives are working for them, not playing political games with their livelihoods!

## **[BREAKING: Court Gives Green Light to EVERY State to Protect Children](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z9usnbov8n5h6f2d1kegs8npfu7enhsrch8qdl78_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1j6cpr2clh2bs)**
Dear Fellow American,

Praise God! The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled, 6-3, in _United States v. Skrmetti_ that states can protect kids from harmful drugs and surgeries. Every child deserves to be kept safe from dangerous procedures.

This is a landmark victory for every child in our country, as the ruling will allow EVERY state to implement similar laws to protect children from the harms of gender ideology.

This win moves us that much closer to finally ending the practice of experimenting on children.
[ DONATE](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z3bkoqf00reopesprcr7andsvavpllibmbamr9qg_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1j6cpr2clh2bs)
**Gender ideology is on the ropes.** Now we have to keep the momentum going and finish the job. Several cases and many clients are still waiting for justice from the lies of gender ideology, including:
* **Selina Soule** --she and several other female athletes have been standing up for fairness on and off the field for years. We've beaten back efforts to rewrite Title IX at the federal level, but many states, like Connecticut, continue to push policies that force girls to compete against male athletes.
* **Dan and Jennifer Mead** --their daughter's school secretly treated her as a boy, as part of the school's "social transition" policy. Many school districts around the country still have these policies in place.
* **Brian and Katy Wuoti** --this loving foster couple had their license revoked because they wouldn't agree to push Vermont's radical gender ideology agenda. They are challenging this illegal policy, along with another family.

[With your gift today,](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zssuua36ri534vp9je24bi8bngonelv51heavjkg_rp22sh2s8i6eor0c1j6cpr2clh2bs) we can represent more clients in court (free of charge) and advocate for more good laws that protect children. **Plus, you can help maximize the impact of a special $250,000 challenge grant!**

Thank you for your support. Countless children are now protected from much of gender ideology's irreversible harms.

In Christ,

John Bursch
Senior Counsel, Vice President of Appellate Advocacy
Alliance Defending Freedom

P.S. Praise God! The Supreme Court has acted decisively to protect children from harmful drugs and procedures, ruling 6-3, in _United States v. I hope you’ll read the message below from her, and [**rush a split donation between Katie's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-hobbs.0syrPb&refcode=em251009-1-90&t=1&akid=6212%2E6688874%2EMFHfEq)

[**If you’re with me, will you split a donation between me and Mark Kelly and become a Founding Donor of my re-election campaign? This race is already being called the most competitive toss-up governor’s race in 2026, and I’m counting on your early support to power us to victory.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-hobbs.0syrPb&refcode=em251009-1-90&t=3&akid=6212%2E6688874%2EMFHfEq)

**I’m running to serve you for four more years because our work to deliver on the Arizona Promise has only just begun. From cutting taxes for middle-class families, small businesses, and veterans, to lowering childcare costs and erasing medical debt for over 350,000 Arizonans, I’m focused on creating real solutions for our state’s toughest challenges – unlike the Washington politicians who prefer to play partisan games.**
I’m proud to be the first social worker ever elected governor in this country. Arizonans don’t need out-of-touch, career politicians who care more about billionaires than working families – they deserve leaders who actually understand the struggles we face.
I know what working families are going through — because I’ve lived it. I grew up in a working-class family in the heart of Tempe. I worked at Burger King and Pizza Hut to put myself through school. I lost my home in the Great Recession. I drove for Uber to make ends meet. My husband and I are still paying off student loans.
**That’s why every decision I make as governor is about delivering real results for families, not playing Washington political games.**
But all our progress is on the line in this election.
Donald Trump and National Republicans have made the Arizona governor’s race one of their top targets to flip red in 2026, and they’re prepared to spend whatever it takes to do it. It’s why political experts at the _Cook Political Report_ , Larry Sabato’s Crystal Ball, and Inside Elections have already called this race a **pure toss-up.**
It’s why Trump has endorsed not one, but **TWO** of my *three* GOP opponents.
But unlike my Trump-endorsed opponents, I don’t have a vast personal fortune or far-right billionaires on speed dial. I have something far better: **You.**
[**So please: Split a donation between me and Mark Kelly and become a Founding Donor of my re-election campaign today. clean_body: Our work to keep moving Arizona forward has only just begun, and the stakes in this race are sky-high. Hey friend, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Katie Hobbs is running for Governor in Arizona and needs our help. I hope you’ll read the message below from her, and Team, it’s Katie. I wanted you to hear it from me first: I’m officially running for re-election as governor of Arizona. I’m running to serve you for four more years because our work to deliver on the Arizona Promise has only just begun. From cutting taxes for middle-class families, small businesses, and veterans, to lowering childcare costs and erasing medical debt for over 350,000 Arizonans, I’m focused on creating real solutions for our state’s toughest challenges – unlike the Washington politicians who prefer to play partisan games. I’m proud to be the first social worker ever elected governor in this country. Arizonans don’t need out-of-touch, career politicians who care more about billionaires than working families – they deserve leaders who actually understand the struggles we face. I know what working families are going through — because I’ve lived it. I grew up in a working-class family in the heart of Tempe. I worked at Burger King and Pizza Hut to put myself through school. I lost my home in the Great Recession. I drove for Uber to make ends meet. My husband and I are still paying off student loans. That’s why every decision I make as governor is about delivering real results for families, not playing Washington political games. But all our progress is on the line in this election. Donald Trump and National Republicans have made the Arizona governor’s race one of their top targets to flip red in 2026, and they’re prepared to spend whatever it takes to do it. It’s why political experts at the Cook Political Report , Larry Sabato’s Crystal Ball, and Inside Elections have already called this race a pure toss-up.
