It’s an exciting time to be in Mississippi. Over the past few years, our state has made incredible strides — growing jobs, attracting new investment, expanding educational opportunity, and leading the way in innovation and reform. We’ve seen record-low unemployment, historic school achievement, and new industries choosing Mississippi as home. Our people’s hard work, resilience, and vision have turned challenges into real success stories. That’s what _A Celebration of Mississippi Success_ on **Thursday, October 23rd** at the **Country Club of Jackson** is all about — recognizing how far we’ve come and the leaders who have helped make it happen.

name: Elizabeth Nader
subject: Two Roxbury moms win in defamation suit brought by librarian
body:
Peter, I love a good win for moms fighting for their kids against the madness of the Lunatic Left. And this week, we got one.
| | [ ]()
---
Peter, I love a good win for moms fighting for their kids against the madness of the Lunatic Left. And this week, we got one. Just before the weekend, news broke that two heroic Roxbury moms – **Kristen Cobo** and **Christina Balestriere** – [won a MAJOR victory](https://xtz223.keap-link001.com/v2/click/5005e4d278326a95bc74b9f700d960d3/eJyNkMFuwjAMht8lZ0xEgTH1hhBCVRmHaTtPaWu1gS6JYpfSId59ZiBOm7STJfvL5_w-K0ZnHGeVStWJv5JkqkYqYmmDRccr79iUP9NkPptMJyPVWnfYRN8FlZ5_ffwAru3n5Gk-UjwEFOTtdbnKs93mY5vtciGDibLjX57FbLF4eNYvy2yrLpc_xfhpeX0UN6mUY4fXRJWVVPweW-Eb5kCp1n3fj9kE69iPHbJm3zvS0Z-KLg6ahLdeGq3pwbgK9h2xLVGbKKVF0vuuqhHYEyGBUNRZhkL-XDdSB7iboLF1A1Q23rfQ2iKaaI0DUxvriOF2BgJ_xAiF9weSCCYEdNX9_jkOtyCXb6oRlYU=) against the Roxbury High School Librarian **Roxana Caivano** who had sued them for _defamation._ And why? Because these bold moms dared to use their voice to speak up against sexually explicit materials being offered to _minors_ in the school library under the supervision of this very librarian. And not just the supervision – but the _encouragement._ She placed these books in prime view of every student entering the library. The judge didn’t mince words in handing down a victory to Kristen and Christina. He said “This was all protected expression of opinion...I find it hard to believe how anyone can think it was other than that...I find it rich that the plaintiff...can turn around and view this obviously protected speech as defamation.” I have to give major props to brilliant attorney, John Coyle, who defended Kristen and Christina and was a master in leading the legal strategy that architected this critical win. We need more bold and strategic legal minds like his if we are to see more common sense victories in the courts. This was a win for parental rights and, frankly, plain old common sense. If you have the stomach for it, let me give you a preview of some of the materials these moms were trying to protect children in their community from being exposed to... The books included...
* _Let’s Talk About It_
* _This Book is Gay_
* _Lawn Boy_
* _Gender Queer,_
* _Flamer_
* _Me and Earl and the Dying Girl_

These books were filled with content inappropriate for minors, such as...
* How to use the sexual connection app Grindr (keep in mind, this is a book the librarian was offering _minors!)_
* Positive portrayals of sexting
* How to give a good hand job
* How to “eat the pussy” and other crass and inappropriate language unsuitable for minors
* Depictions of all kinds of sex acts and sexual behaviors

In any other scenario, an adult giving these kinds of sexual materials to a child would be a felony. But in the context of a school library, it’s ok? Not to these moms it wasn’t. And most Common Sense New Jerseyans would agree. The librarian who brought the suit tried to claim the usual – that these moms were racist, homophobic book burners. But what these moms were objecting to had nothing to do with race or sexual orientation and everything to do with exposing minors to sexually explicit material of any kind that research has made clear is dangerous to young minds. Let this be a lesson to other dangerous lunatics who not only use their position to put the minds of young people at risk, but who try to subvert our laws to punish anyone who stands up to them. THIS is a win to put them in their place and say, ‘enough of this! We’re fighting for our kids and we’re going to keep winning.’ Bravo, Kristen and Christina. That’s how you fight for Common Sense. For New Jersey, Elizabeth Nader

Hochul and the Democrats were desperately hoping that I would continue to pause my messaging during the shutdown so that they could bury this news and prevent us from seizing the momentum. * * *
I've gotten into a bad habit lately--waking up every morning and checking to see what new horror ICE has unleashed on the people of Chicago.
Yesterday, it was a video of an agent shooting a priest in the head with a pepper ball. This morning? Two guys just having coffee, standing there--when suddenly, ICE agents come running at them. They had to sprint into a building just to avoid getting snatched off the street. Horrifying.
A few hours after I saw the priest video, Trump threatened to arrest Governor Pritzker and Mayor Johnson. ICE raids are ripping through this city. Federal agents in helmets are hunting kids outside schools. And now the President of the United States is openly talking about jailing elected officials.
This isn't law enforcement--it's harassment. It's fascism.
What we're seeing right now is some of the worst this nation has to offer. The violence, the fear--it's intentional. It's part of the strategy. But there's another side to it. There are good people in this city fighting hard to keep our brothers and sisters safe. To protect our kids.
Moments like this show you the worst of society, for sure. But they also reveal the best. And I choose to try to see the best in us.
Yesterday, I met with some local elected officials to talk about protecting the school around the corner from my house. It's 40% Hispanic. I'll keep the details private, but my alderman told me attendance is way down among Hispanic families at public schools. Local restaurants are getting crushed. Immigrant workers are too afraid to go to their jobs. Families are running out of money. Their kids are at risk.
What the hell are we doing?
National Guard trucks. National Guard troops. Rolled into our city from Texas. Soldiers and ICE agents patrolling Michigan Avenue. Entire hotels in the suburbs commandeered by ICE. Helicopters circling at night. Schools being targeted at drop-off and pick-up.
It's intimidation. A show of force. A reminder of who holds the power--and who doesn't.
And of course, the communities bearing the brunt of this terror are the same ones this country has always forced to carry its weight. Once again, they're being punished--for wanting a better life. For wanting to earn that life here, in Chicago, and across the country just like the rest of us.
And that's not right.
* * *
_**[Endless Urgency is free to read, but we're hustling to launch our new content studio and pay our new Community Manager a living wage. Paid subscribers make it all possible--just $8/month if you're down to support](https://substack.com/redirect/4038c8cf-650e-41c9-b983-946fbc4d1a43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): **_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/4038c8cf-650e-41c9-b983-946fbc4d1a43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
I'm still figuring out what role I want to play in all this--how I can be useful beyond just going live on Substack and posting these rants. I believe that work matters, but there's got to be more. For me, right now, it's about showing up in my neighborhood.
There's this idea that what's happening in Chicago is isolated to a few areas. It's not. ICE is getting bolder, expanding everywhere. Families and kids are at risk on the North Side, South Side--all over. No place is safe.
Like I said: there's a school down the street I'm involved with. It has a sizable Hispanic population. Those parents are scared. Those kids are scared. They deserve to feel safe at school, if nowhere else--so they can learn, grow, thrive.
If they don't get that support, those kids are going to be set back forever. And I'm going to do what I can to stop that.
Right now, national Democrats are focused on the shutdown, which is understandable. But we need more attention from Washington and the media on what's happening in Chicago--and, I assume, a lot of other cities.
Donald Trump and his ICE agents are manufacturing chaos. Trying to provoke more violence from protesters so they can escalate. So they can invoke the Insurrection Act. So they can declare martial law--and then God knows what.
How else are we supposed to interpret this? The images we're seeing, the stories I'm hearing--from neighbors, friends, elected officials?
The nation's got to turn its attention here.
* * *
_**[Endless Urgency is free to read, but we're hustling to launch our new content studio and pay our new Community Manager a living wage. Paid subscribers make it all possible--just $8/month if you're down to support](https://substack.com/redirect/4038c8cf-650e-41c9-b983-946fbc4d1a43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): **_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/4038c8cf-650e-41c9-b983-946fbc4d1a43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
And maybe Trump and Mike Johnson are so obsessed with the shutdown not just because they don't care about your tripling healthcare premiums. Maybe it's not just about stalling the Epstein discharge petition.
Maybe it's also a distraction from what's happening on the ground.
I don't know. I don't know what it's going to take for this country to wake up and act.
Do I need to beg Pope Leo to come home and stand up for our people? He's put out statements. He's directed the bishops--and I applaud that. But do we need him here physically in order for people to pay attention?
I don't know.
And remember: the fear, the rage, the anger--that's the point. They want people scared enough to stop organizing. Overwhelmed enough to stop caring. They want apathy. But like I said the other day, anger and rage without action is just rot.
They want to rot you from the inside. I want you to feel that anger--and turn it into peaceful and meaningful action. I want you to figure out how to be useful in your community.
Because right now, I'm watching parents build carpools so kids get to school safely, so they don't get snatched by ICE on the way. I'm watching teachers and principals refuse to let ICE into school buildings. I'm watching group chats light up with info, people coordinating in real time. I saw a video of South Side Chicago residents chasing off ICE when they tried to snatch a man. I'm seeing neighborhoods stand up and look out for each other.
Those acts of resistance are what's holding Chicago together--and I am damn proud of this city.
But we need more. We need structural accountability. We need the city and state to keep stepping up. We likely need legal defense funds. Independent oversight. We need Democrats in Washington to hold hearings, drag this into the light, force media coverage--force the public to look.
We need people loud online--and we need people physically present here. In this city. In your city.
And we need to elevate the voices of those most impacted.
I want to hear from the families whose doors were kicked in. From the people hogtied in the middle of the night after a Blackhawk helicopter attacked their apartment complex. From the teachers watching kids break down in class because they don't know what's going to happen to their parents--or to themselves. From the kids who don't know where their parents are.
People need to hear these stories. To understand: these are not faceless, undocumented immigrants. These are not criminals. These are kids. Workers. Neighbors. People who love. People who bleed the same as the rest of us.
We need that.
And yeah, some Democratic strategists will say, "Stay focused on the economy. On healthcare premiums." And sure--I've said that too. Democrats have largely done well messaging the shutdown around healthcare.
But we've got to walk and chew gum.
Because this abuse of executive power isn't just about Chicago. It's everywhere.
You think Trump is going to stop?
He's the definition of "give a mouse a cookie." He's taking the whole damn box.
If you think he's only sending 300 National Guard troops to Chicago to "protect" Broadview, I've got a bridge to sell you.
It's going to get worse. It's going to spread.
We've seen Democratic leaders in Illinois stand up and organize. That's good. We need more. We need better.
And we have to keep showing up--for our kids at school. For each other.
What I saw in the protests downtown last night was powerful. We need that kind of energy at the No Kings Rally on October 18th. We need people showing up at detention centers. We need them to know we're watching. That we're documenting. That we're holding them accountable--and we will not back down.
Democracy is a verb, right?
It takes action. Beyond the conversation. Beyond the retweets and quote posts.
You've got to find your way to be useful.
What are you good at? How can you help?
If you're doing that, you're part of the million acts of resistance that'll get us through this. That'll help save lives.
Do it with love. With compassion. With empathy. With joy in your heart.
Don't let the rage eat you. Let it fuel you.
Be a joyful warrior--for the people who are scared.
Especially the kids.

We've seen Democratic leaders in Illinois stand up and organize. That's good. We need more. We need better. And we have to keep showing up--for our kids at school. For each other. What I saw in the protests downtown last night was powerful. We need that kind of energy at the No Kings Rally on October 18th. We need people showing up at detention centers. We need them to know we're watching. That we're documenting. That we're holding them accountable--and we will not back down. Democracy is a verb, right? It takes action. Beyond the conversation. Beyond the retweets and quote posts. You've got to find your way to be useful. What are you good at? How can you help? If you're doing that, you're part of the million acts of resistance that'll get us through this. That'll help save lives. Do it with love. With compassion. With empathy. With joy in your heart. Don't let the rage eat you. Let it fuel you. Be a joyful warrior--for the people who are scared. Especially the kids. By Illinois Review

President Donald Trump blasted Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker and Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson on Wednesday morning, declaring that both “should be in jail” for issuing executive orders that prohibit local police from helping federal immigration officers. The President accused them of obstructing federal law, endangering U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents, and violating multiple federal statutes designed to protect law enforcement officers.

“Chicago Mayor should be in jail for failing to protect Ice Officers!,” President Trump wrote on Truth Social. “Governor Pritzker also!”

body:
| | | Hi friend, it's Senator Kirsten Gillibrand. I am honored to serve as your Chair of the DSCC.

My entire career, I've believed in **the power of grassroots activism.** I know that campaigns -- and Senate majorities -- are won by the people who put in the work, from volunteers knocking on doors and stuffing envelopes to supporters sharing their priorities. _And that last piece is why I want to hear from you._

**[Today, I'd like to invite you to join my official DSCC Focus Group. Flipping the Senate depends on knowing what issues and messages matter most to this team, so it's important that I personally hear from top supporters like you. Your feedback will enable us to build our strategy to take back the majority -- so please, will you take my survey before midnight?](http://go.dscc.org/go/22096?ask=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20251009-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20251009-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&akid=21431%2E9716520%2E7RxZko)**

| | [ENTER FOCUS GROUP](http://go.dscc.org/go/22096?ask=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20251009-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20251009-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&akid=21431%2E9716520%2E7RxZko)
---

Donald Trump has spent years attacking your personal freedoms, and now that he's back in office, that will only continue.

The Senate is our _best chance_ at stopping the MAGA agenda and putting forth a positive Democratic vision. Together, we can flip the Senate and pursue that bold path, but we'll only be effective if we incorporate _your_ invaluable knowledge of the landscape we face.

**[So please, will you take a few moments to join my DSCC Focus Group by completing a brief survey before midnight? Democrats are at our strongest when we hear from supporters like you, so I'm humbly asking you to take a few moments to share your thoughts on how we can win.](http://go.dscc.org/go/22096?ask=5&t=7&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20251009-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20251009-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&akid=21431%2E9716520%2E7RxZko)**

The path forward starts today. It's a privilege to be your DSCC Chair, and **[with your input](http://go.dscc.org/go/22096?ask=5&t=8&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20251009-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20251009-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&akid=21431%2E9716520%2E7RxZko)** , we'll build our strongest majority yet.

With gratitude,

Kirsten

Kirsten Gillibrand
DSCC Chair

[](http://go.dscc.org/go/22096?ask=5&t=9&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20251009-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20251009-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&akid=21431%2E9716520%2E7RxZko)

| Hi Peter,

I wanted to share a little bit about my journey and why I’m running for Congress in Pennsylvania’s 7th District.

Before I stepped up to run, I had the privilege of serving our community under Senator Bob Casey and Governor Tom Wolf. Those experiences grounded me in public service and inspired me to keep fighting for working families. [_**Before I go on, I hope you’ll consider making a contribution to my campaign today.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116927191/574890037/1877634325?refcode=BLU_EM_CODC_2025-10-09_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc2MjgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmQ1YWQ5Y2MtMjZhNS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=tdTin_hTuxDxET8m28P_tOuDpT9OWzQ50EDbHCZiehI=)
---
| [CONTRIBUTE ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116927193/574890047/1877634325?refcode=BLU_EM_CODC_2025-10-09_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc2MjgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmQ1YWQ5Y2MtMjZhNS1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=tdTin_hTuxDxET8m28P_tOuDpT9OWzQ50EDbHCZiehI=)
---
In 2011, Senator Casey asked me to serve as his Regional Manager in Lehigh, Northampton, and Carbon Counties. I worked one-on-one with thousands of people, helping them cut through red tape and connect with services that made a real difference in their lives. I went to bat for families every single day, and I’m proud to have delivered results.

Before I stepped up to run, I had the privilege of serving our community under Senator Bob Casey and Governor Tom Wolf. Those experiences grounded me in public service and inspired me to keep fighting for working families. = | = In 2011, Senator Casey asked me to serve as his Regional Manager in Lehigh, Northampton, and Carbon Counties. I worked one-on-one with thousands of people, helping them cut through red tape and connect with services that made a real difference in their lives. I went to bat for families every single day, and I’m proud to have delivered results. = Later, I joined Governor Wolf’s Advisory Commission on Latino Affairs, representing the Lehigh Valley. I pushed for policies that supported working families, expanded opportunity, and ensured our community had a voice at the table in Harrisburg. = Those lessons stick with me today:listen to people, understand their struggles, and act with urgency to make life better. # Candidate Spotlight

|
---
**ADELE MCCLURE FOR FOR HD-2** Delegate Adele McClure represents the 2nd District in the Virginia House of Delegates, which includes parts of Arlington County. Born and raised in Northern Virginia, she is the daughter of a Filipino immigrant and veteran and an early childhood educator. Her lived experience with poverty and inequity drives her work to expand opportunity, advance human rights, and improve access to critical services for communities across Virginia. clean_body: | | | Across the Commonwealth | NEW TOOL TO CUT ELECTRIC BILLS IN VIRGINIA The Virginia Department of Energy recently launched an online platform, called Energy Connect, which aims to make clean power and energy efficiency incentives more accessible, including tax credits, loans and direct assistance. The goal is to help people lower their monthly electricity bills while also reducing stress on the regional power grid. | | VOTE EARLY! It's a beautiful day to VOTE EARLY! If you live in Roanoke City, come down to 317 Kimball Ave NE Monday - Friday 8:30-4:30 pm to vote early. If you live outside of Roanoke, find where to vote . | Election 2025 - Get Involved! | | Don't get complacent, come out and canvass! There will be an informative discussion on how you can get involved in the campaign, and an opportunity to knock doors. Whether you're new to volunteering or an experienced activist, there are plenty of ways to help Sam win this election! Williamson Road Library is located at 3837 Williamson Rd NW. ~~ | Please join local Democrats in Roanoke County to knock on doors for Lily Franklin and all Democrats on the ballot this November! First time canvassing? Don't worry, they'll provide all the training and cheerleading you need. Thank you so much for all of your help and support. Let's win this thing! ~ | MY FIRST TV AD - STARRING MY TEACHERS! I was raised by Roanoke to serve Roanoke. These awesome teachers would know - because they helped raise me! My fifth-grade teacher, Ms. Lori Hall, and my third-grade teacher, Dr. Marylen Harmon, helped shape me into the person I am. Their guidance in my childhood and our friendship today have inspired me throughout my life of public service. In Richmond, I have fought hard to bring salary raises to our educators, fully fund our schools, and create learning environments where all can thrive. As Chairman of the House Education Committee, I am committed to making sure teachers like Dr. Harmon and Mrs. Hall have all they need to thrive in the classroom. | Candidate Spotlight | | ADELE MCCLURE FOR FOR HD-2 Delegate Adele McClure represents the 2nd District in the Virginia House of Delegates, which includes parts of Arlington County. Born and raised in Northern Virginia, she is the daughter of a Filipino immigrant and veteran and an early childhood educator. Her lived experience with poverty and inequity drives her work to expand opportunity, advance human rights, and improve access to critical services for communities across Virginia. As Delegate, she represents the needs of the people in Arlington and works to build upon the progress that we've made together. ~ | SHELLY SIMONDS FOR HD-70 Delegate Shelly Simonds represents the 70th District, including part of Newport News, in the Virginia House of Delegates. A former teacher and school board member, she is a leader in workforce and STEM education as co-founder of the Career and Technical Education Caucus. She serves as Vice Chair of the House Education Committee and sits on the Finance, Counties Cities and Towns, and Agriculture and Natural Resources Committees. Shelly lives in the Denbigh area with her husband, Paul, and their two daughters. ~ | KAREN KEYS-GAMARRA FOR HD-7 Delegate Karen Keys-Gamarra represents the 7th District in the Virginia House of Delegates. A family law attorney and longtime child advocate, she previously served as an at-large member of the Fairfax County School Board and on the County Planning Commission. Karen has worked with nonprofits to combat domestic violence, served as a Guardian ad Litem for children, and is a graduate of EMERGE Virginia. A Fairfax resident for over 20 years, she and her husband, Antoine, have raised three sons in a three-generation household. ~~ | In the Community | | 60 YEARS OF TAP CELEBRATION Total Action for Progress turns 60 this year! Communities are only as good as the folks working in them, and TAP have some of the best! TAP changes lives every day, and it is more important now than ever to support their work. | HISPANIC LOCAL COLORS 2025 Last week, we celebrated Hispanic Heritage Month in our Roanoke community at Hispanic Local Colors! We must always stand together in celebration of our diversity, even in challenging times. ~~ | VINTON FALL FESTIVAL - Oct. 11 Get ready to celebrate the season at the Annual Vinton Fall Festival! Join the Vinton community in downtown Vinton for a day filled with fun, food, and festivities for the whole family. The festival is from 10 am - 4 pm in Downtown Vinton. Admission is free. ~ | SWVA PRIDE FEST 2025 - Oct. 11 Celebrate love, diversity, and unity at the 4th Annual Southwest Virginia Pride Fest, a vibrant, community-driven event for all ages! Held at the Salem Civic Center on October 11th from 12-7 pm, this year's festival is embracing the theme United in Pride to bring people together in the spirit of inclusivity and support. ~~ | GAZA SINCE OCT 7TH - Oct. 11 Join Plowshare Peace Center and Justice Center and the Southwest Virginia Coalition for Palestine for short lectures and open dialogue after two years of ethnic cleansing, terror bombing, and forced starvation in Gaza. They are hosting guest lecturers Dr. Mazen Hasan, Rafeeq McNamara and Dr. Jack Leff at the United Universalist Church on Oct 11th at 2 pm. Further opportunities to engage on the issue, get involved, and support Gazan families will be available. | CRYSTAL SPRING BLOCK PARTY - Oct.12 Crystal Spring Block Party: a neighborhood celebration with Music, Food, Drinks, & Friends on Sunday, October 12th, starting at 3 pm. Join The River and Rail Restaurant as they celebrate some milestones: 13 Years at River and Rail, 5 Years at Crystal Spring Grocery, and 3 years at Yard Bull Meats. Altogether, that makes them 21 and all grown up! ~~ | | | NATIONAL CUSTODIAN APPRECIATION DAY Last week, RCPS celebrated National Custodian Appreciation Day! Building operations staff keep our schools clean, safe, beautiful, and running smoothly. Make sure you thank our unsung heroes who build relationships with our students and create a safe and positive learning environment! | ROANOKE FAFSA FIRE FALL 2025 Need help with FAFSA or VASA? The Roanoke Higher Education Center is hosting FAFSA Fire on October 18 from 10 am - 12 pm. This is a free event with financial aid experts ready to help! Registration is required! | Community Resources | LEGAL AID SOCIETY OF ROANOKE VALLEY The Legal Aid Society of Roanoke Valley provides a full range of civil legal services to low-income area residents, including issues involving housing, family, employment, consumer debt, and domestic violence. Free legal services are provided to qualified residents of the cities of Roanoke and Salem, along with the counties of Roanoke, Botetourt, Craig, Bedford, and Franklin. | | KNOW YOUR RIGHTS WITH ICE There have been recent reports of ICE throughout the state. The ACLU has created a collection of resources in the case you or someone you know interacts with ICE agents. Read and share the resources found ~~. ~~ | CONTACT YOUR FEDERAL REPRESENTATIVE In many ways, it feels like our federal government is under attack by the current administration. While our office is happy to assist however we can, it is still crucial that you engage our federal representatives. Find the contact information for the Virginia Congressional Delegation ~~. ~~ | JOIN THE ROANOKE CITY DEMOCRATS! RCDC's monthly business meeting is the third Thursday each month. Watch their Facebook for an upcoming announcement of the agenda. The meetings are available virtually for those who write to mailto:info@roanokedemocrats.com, requesting the link. ~~ | JOIN ROANOKE YOUNG DEMS! Meetings occur on the second Monday of every month in person and virtually. The goal of RYD is to help improve our community and to promote the names of Democratic candidates and policies. Contact: mailto:youngdemocratsroanoke@gmail.com to get involved! | VIRTUAL OFFICE HOURS WITH DEL. RASOUL'S TEAM Our office is now holding virtual office hours to meet with constituents. Meet with a member of Delegate Sam Rasoul's team to ask questions, share concerns, or get help with state-related issues. We're here to listen and assist however we can. If you are unable to join virtually, or you have a pressing matter, we can always be reached at (540) 904-6905 or mailto:DelSRasoul@house.virginia.gov. ~~ | Thank you for your support! If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to me anytime. My very best, | Del. body:
Over the last couple of days, I’ve been reflecting on everything we built together and I keep coming back to one thing: gratitude.

| | | | | Peter, Over the last couple of days, I’ve been reflecting on everything we built together and I keep coming back to one thing: gratitude. We showed that a campaign rooted in everyday people, not old school politics, can still move hearts and minds and shift conversations. We reached voters who had given up. Peter, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, _" You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois."_ So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving.
[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=44aef218a83042b68c9b09090194929e&_e=mH17mbvOtvAvYhFIq9ItU6f6e5jrS-IK0NaPUwQFwmazHULwKmBX6tMpV7ROFOue8gXI-fzt1CjdpSJAj_OcmizIFQAiaggF8d_DX821tCFb6E8YRNr18FLOsouxBkz4hIKXlp1NO2yPujInRKK63XSF5ykoZS_EjgWjSLGqcUsGilQ_OLebloVbdGukyKwcNsMkxUMjablbItaeWZJqU6ahyjgcVtxsJRCkxk9HltjDWX4Z0w-2IOQP52SGUNiI-Q0hk6JFD3LHte1GeAuJHiNyOhrNcEBkI8cojaLBeZihTqLlYhLoaM3hcwdmVXXZVl1ac4nDpZ9B_oStuc8rmn_2B8lkqOK-X1yXqMPpG-I_mXKL-fRVHws_iIDAYl1c6D_cLbslJiG8iBDSgBNKB0ZpyC6PP9c-1aa18r0MDxdYWDS4G0sZErJVwTo3X-3-eB1zn8WiWYBOykhmLGwuCgWgNgoS5yzdcq3SwKHw_SG-R90yaeVaWNKUd7kSxIoxePd4aTDpJ7QEC9X9rWgQkgVdRRph9LCCr6_5PwoULE96lP39AKUPsGf_KQ98PtMEY9oCipwEQRDKEVqEQ5V81RN7AZbzDMJ3rjSe4Q_4MCmYObeRUeTcMr6gJJUkNHNQdtwbBxoUQQ1MlM4eqJ02lcar6BQeS9tfNoPvgf4G_ZQRG8hYUB7UsYp4Rgt_WnyXz6977CScsN8LTh1MlxIm2w%3D%3D)
_**Above:** The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. _
Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... _I knew._ Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. **Faith, family, freedom** -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? _He did it._ He didn't just build a brand... _He built a machine._ First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it _from the start._ Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together.
[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=44aef218a83042b68c9b09090194929e&_e=mH17mbvOtvAvYhFIq9ItU6f6e5jrS-IK0NaPUwQFwmazHULwKmBX6tMpV7ROFOue8gXI-fzt1CjdpSJAj_OcmizIFQAiaggF8d_DX821tCFb6E8YRNr18FLOsouxBkz4hIKXlp1NO2yPujInRKK63XSF5ykoZS_EjgWjSLGqcUsGilQ_OLebloVbdGukyKwcNsMkxUMjablbItaeWZJqU6ahyjgcVtxsJRCkxk9HltjDWX4Z0w-2IOQP52SGUNiIiufAF6fj-gT0fSQN112_L3Pb8h3-ZxwuYdV16AtJb8ps-hJXSeY8tBNN7V93B6NHcRG9O3FyeFnyJau8aastOOJdc-ASpDJYwPGIplB1dNItYy0cE9v9_ir5Jt3qHPPi6pxjLxFdysoDAAAdM7ikMEbunSIjg0gqEfztd2k-gT-WE__2CpdC3V6JCQ5vLstQ7QMZ1NFqYnnposS3iVuXBwt9IuOEvmhLONVslcXOjWS2ZlQVjVCBrLm-AfNppFdx_4Q9Rg-OxXcppC_AHOPxXIE9_Vl_Beqspf1IVcATy0cQVSBIFd1tqFj6JLFfZGyWgSoSVhJJhnkoRac9rOyi-xE_CD7MwZ59nuDTB7z_eNd45BirWQSccwV3_a0OaNtMjD4a4WWTcaFgks9cIr2G274cRCPTgHjpTAAQLa4vaggceiaxC9UdhQIf7yyAjY0YtPIAVWX0DQly7HkvL-bcfQ%3D%3D)
We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. **And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. ** We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- _and it delivered real results._ 10 for 10. **In every single state we operated in... Trump won.** In Arizona _alone,_ we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. _In Wisconsin?_ 60,000+. _In Nevada?_ 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. _In Michigan?_ 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... _We made history. _
[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=44aef218a83042b68c9b09090194929e&_e=mH17mbvOtvAvYhFIq9ItU6f6e5jrS-IK0NaPUwQFwmazHULwKmBX6tMpV7ROFOue8gXI-fzt1CjdpSJAj_OcmizIFQAiaggF8d_DX821tCFb6E8YRNr18FLOsouxBkz4hIKXlp1NO2yPujInRKK63XSF5ykoZS_EjgWjSLGqcUsGilQ_OLebloVbdGukyKwcNsMkxUMjablbItaeWZJqU6ahyjgcVtxsJRCkxk9HltjDWX4Z0w-2IOQP52SGUNiIMGhEXcAGEB15vOHEqN7QgH6O_BwmkjWjicU14-mjJZVBJL6OSFMGSq70qz-ti7tREnK55lCL9tqNeJp5vue57UBXPBJxdJN1F0NTZBWORHooM4WWEYgwrPZEnm7yXETYGc4zeHQtWCDWPRB7hi211AUIhwFKwCfwouayYQ8GDCWCW1eDnf9UXYNi_WCHFxZ6t_QfogTIpZw0NIdH7m1lFi5Oq_ArziDgksgeqBCezncNhyuBuB79NzaM4IGmoqHGknMM-flqAXG97_4xXQEIAuUBOpbM8g9i_FU5fmltRO6niBTAf25QGT48PzETio0gK4I0_zP6f1b4lIW33RM5inFjkb-xQO8lcL9885wLP8G9UdUu1sUuqcy-sDrKZIVRC583u7xNjB2hvR8FNMIs37kQvOLvZ-MEqTVmepIAgFcp2WhIicj27WW7Xd9x_E-qrwoPnP0GTno4Js-zlrFYxw%3D%3D)
_**Above:** Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _
Peter, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _ He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? **We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- ****_and make it stronger than ever._** Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- _we must turn it into action._ He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: _" What are we building next?"_ **Well, Peter, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time.**
[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=44aef218a83042b68c9b09090194929e&_e=mH17mbvOtvAvYhFIq9ItU6f6e5jrS-IK0NaPUwQFwmazHULwKmBX6tMpV7ROFOue8gXI-fzt1CjdpSJAj_OcmizIFQAiaggF8d_DX821tCFb6E8YRNr18FLOsouxBkz4hIKXlp1NO2yPujInRKK63XSF5ykoZS_EjgWjSLGqcUsGilQ_OLebloVbdGukyKwcNsMkxUMjablbItaeWZJqU6ahyjgcVtxsJRCkxk9HltjDWX4Z0w-2IOQP52SGUNiIU1bi8PtsMLjd5OTEP0ZlKH2ppZHrItBB4dwMt2Es91OTbkYgEd75B5JC_wcrWbRZnSi8S2dshJ4SNRbqWdbS84kD1D5D3JfYSCmC920nxFk8G5-Dq-Fj2v4urABJiz6wXhAgAzEpGtlpvzEWEKBY2XR-zn18xCL3W9cObvtw7ovdSaEczYd9-iVB2ufyugNqCa6TR6s7xlTknInxC68dIAFPMWJsUy3EPJLwa143zhpIUe5_SPtBuKvUf3lCpsXE5QGsRJdEIU5mnodOmCAfXvejqDRg3Pu8oXeZ5sPVYe271jl_1sAabnxRNZoCCRtfGMdV00SZzk86L6xNmp15tvMoRUB6FqmtxriRIw6H3sEIc8_ofiuOHwmRsjIczK1pvgi7hheXnUpCVPPOddOsgUWv0axXtILsXLWL2szIHwcQ2FPArnMahGvnAmDGw16l6EVlv1ie2h8aTFlJQ-no8Q%3D%3D)
**But it doesn 't happen without you.** _So, here 's my ask..._ Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie. Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie. Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work.
**For Charlie.** **God Bless,** **Tyler Bowyer**
Chief Operating Officer

clean_body: Charlie built the machine. Let’s make him proud. A tribute to Charlie & Turning Point Action—see how to help and double your impact today. | Peter, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, " You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois." So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving. Above: The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... I knew. Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. Faith, family, freedom -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? He did it. He didn't just build a brand... He built a machine. First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it from the start. Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together. We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- and it delivered real results. 10 for 10. In every single state we operated in... Trump won. In Arizona alone, we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. In Wisconsin? 60,000+. In Nevada? 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. In Michigan? 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... We made history. Above: Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. Peter, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. Because Charlie never stopped. He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- and make it stronger than ever. Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- we must turn it into action. He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: " What are we building next?" Well, Peter, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time. But it doesn 't happen without you. So, here 's my ask... Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie. Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie. Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work. For Charlie. God Bless, Tyler Bowyer Chief Operating Officer Turning Point Action P.S. I would give anything to have Charlie back. But he left us with something powerful -- a machine that works... a machine that's proven and battle-tested. Now it's time to run it -- and run it like never before. Bigger. Bolder. More battlegrounds. More victories. Because right now, thanks to a generous supporter of Turning Point Action, your gift will be matched dollar-for-dollar -- up to $500,000, through October 31. That means, with your gift today: ✅ 2X the activists trained ✅ 2X the voters registered ✅ 2X the pressure on weak-kneed politicians ✅ 2X the ballot-chasing operations ✅ 2X the grassroots strength the Left can't stop We don't need to reinvent anything. Charlie already drew the blueprint and turned the key. So, if you've been wondering how to help... If you've been asking " what now?" Then, Peter, this is your moment to step in, fuel the fight, and take Charlie 's vision to the next level. Let's turn this energy -- this momentum -- into action. name: American Vitality
subject: Kevin Sorbo begs you
body:
American made health supplements

Hi there,
A few years ago, I experienced a series of strokes that shocked me to my core.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Padora for Colorado
body:

---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/1i_a7XN5tuuUErUjcJAWfg~~/AAUS1hA~/rJaleE5v0i59wGIeZgmPnoVW0R8nViVhsa5bDGAqVMy9FCU20FBTOBemJQ5K6vYriRoPE2Ba6tJBLXsuhY9udtbIR9gyqBagFRF1VEBTHxMoQlBceqlS_64_pwaKKVXv)
| | Everyone’s saying it, team, and so am I: **Democrats _have_ to meet the moment.** Extremists are willing to let people suffer just to hold onto power. They’re willing to threaten paychecks, drive up health care costs, create an environment of fear and uncertainty, and make ordinary families bear the consequences of their obsession with control. It’s frustrating, it’s unfair, and it affects real people — neighbors, friends, and families across our country. **But instead of being discouraged, I’m determined**. Determined to step up, to help motivate others, and to show that even in these darkest moments, we can still act with empathy and focus on real solutions. name: Beth Van Duyne
subject: We came up short — but I’m not backing down.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BETH VAN DUYNE FOR CONGRESS
body:
If anything, I’m more determined than ever to bounce back, stronger, faster, and louder than the Left could ever imagine. |
---
Fellow American,

I want to speak to you directly this morning — not as “Team Beth,” not as some polished campaign update — but as Beth.

We closed the books on our end-of-quarter deadline. I’ll be honest: we came up short of what my finance team expected.

That stings. Because I know how much was riding on those numbers. Reporters, party insiders, and, yes, even my opponents will dissect our report when it comes out — line by line — and look for weaknesses.

And to make matters worse, **we’re now on day 7 of the Democrat shutdown** — all because the Left is demanding billions in taxpayer dollars to fund **free healthcare for illegal immigrants** in places like **California, Illinois, and New York** while hardworking Texans are left waiting for answers.

You can bet they’ll use this shutdown to score political points — but here in Texas, we’re focused on getting Washington working again for the people who actually pay the bills.

But here’s the truth: campaigns aren’t won or lost in one deadline. [**They’re won by how we _respond_.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=2a72b46f6d9f4670af43fb381dd9f4ff&_e=9IhLCb5Oh5k28jdatM4gZBin0dYKZqhFOM1qcf5OvmecPiMxcXhMyi0Uk6xfoi5xOWzy3g1pmYLzCPfJw_KvArYXtJgeh67wOqvGTpwm_BpYY0zMRG1tMILTfaXIeuUD1ungwlUAQIAb3DWMF2JJg_UPUjdw0FKTa5V3RX_Cgx1EKH6rNEHEEL7DvxAe65ri7OvxkrSMcCFV3qLqkE8usTlUxpP_fhymIPW9kHXJm4UEpu8epMcFY2CuXd1YEhhwDgr2Ol_7oXJMj-QRLiXFjizwthwYfRSpOJjS_u8bydx74x4ZUN5_5W4dIpN-xKxnu-1jMESC60y7l-nEBTxY2-RqL6rcZ7DCwwkrPxcis5DrxPIv13XxrcqhIbUaMRtRa1i-zmRETrsmm9RVVSu93Cm-U6ex1Ok0CF64nNe4352jlC8uDeKLUlTNnNrNozkf72xg8pcR3Ef7b3Ut2QxzBm83Suq43yuJKwVMMndod8CKmimgibJ3W_NHpfi0TGNHCBTtrHIMZCGSp6XCCbKwC534gAj1MdejaNRM08STBf-jWTTFWkrSC3tEBPkFklAAUXEnMRUiWu0-E3i1cWZNZSo3ZGojBoO39fIDomYze67Y4UpJ_YBZwOCwTEayZ27CiH449D567wtocOvdS8PqvQ5WJns-LNpn-Wtw4xEnaVvOagFJZCqkLQIoRND3P4hsH9h0JhCpW4y5jQgfpyk9mx8p8-N3hszckZ-Pcj4eD570hL0wze9NB7mwig0CqDRP)

Here’s what I can say, fellow American: I’m not discouraged, and I’m certainly not backing down. **If anything, I’m more determined than ever to bounce back, stronger, faster, and louder than the Left could ever imagine.**

[**I need your help to make that happen. If we can show a surge today — the very first day of this new quarter — it sends an unmistakable message that our campaign — this district — is still unshakable.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=2a72b46f6d9f4670af43fb381dd9f4ff&_e=9IhLCb5Oh5k28jdatM4gZBin0dYKZqhFOM1qcf5OvmecPiMxcXhMyi0Uk6xfoi5xOWzy3g1pmYLzCPfJw_KvArYXtJgeh67wOqvGTpwm_BpYY0zMRG1tMILTfaXIeuUD1ungwlUAQIAb3DWMF2JJg_UPUjdw0FKTa5V3RX_Cgx1EKH6rNEHEEL7DvxAe65ri7OvxkrSMcCFV3qLqkE8usTlUxpP_fhymIPW9kHXJm4UEpu8epMcFY2CuXd1YEhhwDgr2Ol_7oXJMj-QRLiXFjpNDcjdPfcin-i6f8LwNXitfJcb177qcwmbUj18abWOOYqTy4aQV-Qes0a1pwihSlvw2OLQy4_-AuwVp-ejGp_-bSPgYUx8qFWizKZ1bJ3D50UuTE9tnLfthtu3LBMYEcHtGmmng-OJbt2cfMoRAuu35daYsZ9OhzjAIB4MyJ3pfxWlj8QLBQIs5GhUi-tC2LDh7DAwKcvjpohsP6p64vuZ0UxLbU3X8_8Zklx-t4KfMPmUk8BmS9rHW828zZ2F0aLNQEbluP-Ug5ttVrj9f6Z_Hp7cvIIjkdwtyYhrp5K7UwZzOsNeC44ywojRJs0QBx_jpRKyU1dvVWuylEr1b6s48YdUbMfe_8-rY6DKx0Q-zWmPEYSDKlWYZq782uL4Ek2OMkLofizRz4R_TJAGj3IEY4Fk6pD_zSUasA30H2Fu9P6_nCyiAMYlfJS_3Z8SzNctRhSjjy3nv2_2RT6LXoAaWp_rr3IFxvGibe_T4-dvv)

Beth

# **Ferrari 's shares crash as they show off first all-electric supercar **
Ferrari showcased the technology for its first fully electric supercar, set for late-2026 delivery, but stunned investors by **[halving its 2030 EV sales goal](https://substack.com/redirect/3da4037a-26e2-456e-8af7-14518726c228?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to 20%, citing client demands and market shifts--triggering the automaker's worst trading day ever.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3da4037a-26e2-456e-8af7-14518726c228?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Target Slashed Amid Caution** : Ferrari has revised its proposed 2030 lineup to 40% ICE, 40% hybrid, 20% EV--down from prior 40% EV ambition--driven by client preferences and evolving market realities.
* **Shares Plunge in Disappointment** : Stock in the Prancing Horse tumbled 13.2% in Milan and over 12% premarket in U.S, the worst drop since its 2016 listing. Citi has flagged Earnings Per Share risks, while JPMorgan remains bullish on demand for the car maker and its plans to launch four new models to lure fresh buyers.
* **Revenue Outlook Remains Robust** : Forecasts full-year net revenue at €7.1 billion minimum, rising to €9 billion by 2030 with €3.6 billion EBITDA. Ferrari plans four annual launches from 2026 amid 20% client growth.

The news overshadowed Ferrari's unveiling of the powertrain and chassis of its **[inaugural fully electric supercar](https://substack.com/redirect/b489796b-22f5-494f-83b8-88042f23e610?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , the "Elettrica," Thursday.
* **Vibration-Amplified Sports Roar** : Accelerometers on the rear axle capture powertrain vibes, which will amplified into the cabin to provide an authentic Ferrari growl while delivering electric performance.
* **Steering-Linked Power Modes** : Drivers can toggle five power levels via wheel panels, mimicking the "gearshifts" of their iconic V8 beasts such as the 308GTB, 355 and 430.
* **Recycled Aluminum Chassis Build** : 75% recycled materials will slash 6.7 tons of CO2 created per vehicle, with Ferrari blending eco-gains with unyielding performance.

# CoreWeave CEO blasts "circular investment" fears as "fundamentally flawed"
In a fiery CNBC interview, **[CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator slammed Wall Street](https://substack.com/redirect/ab539640-4a54-4817-8266-fb6c2847ebb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** skeptics Tuesday, calling "circular investment" fears over the AI cloud giant's massive tech deals "fundamentally flawed," as his firm's stock surges over 200% since its blockbuster IPO.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a123d7f0-41d9-45f4-9ecc-e306365d5b50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* **Nvidia 's Massive Commitment**: Nvidia, a key backer and supplier, locked in a $6.3 billion deal last month to buy CoreWeave's unused capacity through 2032, cementing deep ties in the AI hardware ecosystem.
* **OpenAI Pact Explodes Value** : Recent expansions ballooned contracts with OpenAI to $22.4 billion, including a fresh $6.5 billion infusion, underscoring the startup's pivotal role in powering cutting-edge AI models.

# PepsiCo goes full MAHA in RADICAL overhaul
PepsiCo CEO Ramon Laguarta revealed Thursday **[a sweeping restructuring](https://substack.com/redirect/a1b31178-d27f-4dd1-a570-0c2f928a381b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of its struggling Frito-Lay division, including 7,000 layoffs and plant closures, to combat declining U.S. snack sales amid activist investor pressure and health crusades.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a0c68f33-63c5-43f0-bdc0-ceddb0995f8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Aggressive Frito-Lay Restructuring Accelerates** : CEO Laguarta described ongoing cost cuts as "very meaningful," with additional plant and warehouse closures planned from May through Q4 to streamline operations.
* **Healthier Snacks Combat Volume Slump** : PepsiCo is ditching artificial flavors in Cheetos and Doritos, expanding avocado and olive oils in Lay's, and boosting brands like Simply, Sabra, and Siete Foods.
* **Innovative Products Target Protein Push** : New launches include Doritos protein chips plus fiber- and grain-enriched options from Quaker, Sun Chips, PopCorners, and Smartfood to reverse 4% unit sales drop.
* **Activist Stakes Fuel Urgent Turnaround** : Elliott Management's $4B investment in September demands snack revival, while RFK Jr.'s MAHA movement adds external scrutiny on junk food giants.

# Dominos Pizza rebrand plays it safe after Cracker Barrel's disaster
In a seismic shift for pizza lovers, **[Domino's Pizza unveiled](https://substack.com/redirect/d46fad00-6164-4f10-a9fd-dc018310aaf0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** its first major rebrand in over a decade on Tuesday, ditching the fiery red color palette for cool blue hues while keeping the signature polka-dot domino symbol--aiming to refresh its image amid fierce fast-food competition.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d46fad00-6164-4f10-a9fd-dc018310aaf0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Red Palette Retired Forever** : The beloved scheme, emblematic since 1965, yields to a modern blue-dominated look to evoke trust and approachability in today's market.
* **Polka Dots Stay Central** : The core domino tile motif remains unchanged, ensuring brand familiarity while subtle tweaks modernize the overall visual identity for digital-savvy consumers.
* **CEO Champions Fresh Start** : Executive leadership hails the update as vital for long-term growth, signaling Domino's commitment to evolution without alienating its loyal base of 20,000+ global stores.
* **Strategic Timing Unveiled** : The launch coincides with peak delivery season, positioning the rebrand to boost visibility and sales through refreshed marketing campaigns across apps and storefronts.

name: Tom Fitton
subject: Thank You For Getting Us Here
body:
Yesterday, Judicial Watch presented oral arguments before the Supreme Court of the United States in our historic Election Integrity case.

| [ | |
---
|
--- ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77097&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) |
---
| Dear Fellow American,

**Yesterday, Judicial Watch presented oral arguments before the Supreme Court of the United States** in our historic Election Integrity case.
We argued on behalf of our client Rep. Mike Bost that candidates have a right to challenge election rules like in Illinois, where ballots received up to 14 days after Election Day can be counted.
The justices expressed many concerns about denying candidates the right to challenge election laws and the Supreme Court seems primed to rule in our favor.
While we won’t know the outcome until opinions are issued, **I want to sincerely THANK YOU** for helping us get this far.
By loyally following our cases, sharing our wins with your friends and family, and staying engaged as a patriotic American citizen,**you are part of making****this righteous effort for honest elections possible.**
Arguing before the Supreme Court is not just a legal milestone for Judicial Watch. It is a powerful reminder of what an army of supporters can achieve together.
Yes, bringing a case to this level requires tireless research from my team. Yes, it also requires expert legal argument from our lawyers.
But undergirding us...are citizens like YOU. **Getting a case to the Supreme Court requires loyal Americans like you who have helped make Judicial Watch America’s impactful public interest law firm**. Citizens who believe, as we do, that honest elections are the cornerstone of a free Republic.
So today, from the bottom of my heart, **thank you**.
_Thank you for standing beside Judicial Watch to fight for Election Integrity on behalf of you and all American voters_.
While the justices deliberate, know this: no matter what the outcome, **we will never stop fighting for fair elections.**
Because this is only the beginning.
Coming off our defeat of Mississippi’s law that also “extended” Election Day by 5 days earlier this year (with your support), and with a full caseload of other Election Integrity litigation in action or on the docket (such fighting California’s similar late-ballot-counting policy), _Judicial Watch is working to the fullest to put the Left and the Deep State on the run and restore faith and confidence to our electoral process_.
It will be a hard fight. But right now, let’s celebrate yesterday’s milestone.
**Yesterday, you brought the voice of honest citizens to the United States Supreme Court.** This is a rare and potentially impactful opportunity to set a precedent in the highest court in the land to protect our elections by making them harder to steal.
I am honored by your trust and commitment to our mutual cause. **We are YOUR Judicial Watch.**
Together, let’s keep breaking new ground for clean elections and the rule of law.
With deep appreciation,
Thomas Fitton President
| [THANK YOU FOR ALL YOUR SUPPORT FOR THE RULE OF LAW. PLEASE CONSIDER A FIRST-TIME FINANCIAL CONTRIBUTION TODAY TO KEEP OUR WORK POSSIBLE ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77097&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

P.S. Thank you again for helping Judicial Watch fight for honest elections at the highest court in the land. _[Your contributions will help ensure Judicial Watch has the resources to continue fighting (and winning) for election integrity](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77097&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_ in the critical year ahead.

The audio from yesterday’s historic oral arguments can be accessed _[https://www.supremecourt.gov/oral_arguments/audio/2025/24-568](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77097&L=36262&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc3VwcmVtZWNvdXJ0Lmdvdi9vcmFsX2FyZ3VtZW50cy9hdWRpby8yMDI1LzI0LTU2OD91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1NYXkmdXRtX3Rlcm09Tm9uLURvbm9ycw==&hash=2c28d20e38cb9668b11a1723259f67e9d659c2dcd8dcdb11bfb8bc0c5714f77a)here._

body:

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **You’re Invited: AI Whistleblower Virtual Panel** _Experts and whistleblowers discuss challenges of exposing risky behavior_
“If you see something, say something.” It’s a mantra we teach our kids, remind employees and highlight for passengers at the airport — a straightforward call to action when potential risks emerge. **But for employees developing advanced artificial intelligence, saying something can mean risking everything.**
Next Thursday, join ARI for a virtual panel with whistleblowers from leading tech companies to discuss the challenges facing employees at leading AI labs and the need for federal protections.
---
| [Register for the Virtual Panel](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=c0169c0855&e=a07d75591f)
---
[|
---](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=162b2a5e8d&e=a07d75591f)
| | **AI Whistleblowers: Empowering Workers to Report AI Risks** _Virtual Panel_ Time: 12:00PM - 1:00PM ETDate: Thursday, October 16, 2025[RSVP here](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=5e96f2437d&e=a07d75591f)

The upcoming panel features experts and whistleblowers from leading tech companies, including:
* _**Moderator**_**: Sophie Luskin** , AI Researcher at Princeton’s Center for Information Technology Policy & Senior Tech Policy Analyst at Kohn, Kohn & Colapinto LLP
* **Jacob Hilton,** whistleblower and former OpenAI employee
* **Holly Alpine,** whistleblower and former Microsoft employee
* **Will Alpine** , whistleblower and former Microsoft employee
* **Jennifer Gibson,** Co-Founder & Director of Psst.org

The upcoming panel follows the introduction of the AI Whistleblower Protection Act by Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA). For more on why federal lawmakers must act to protect whistleblowers, read the op-ed from ARI President Brad Carson and AI researcher Kevin Frazier, [_Why We Need a ‘Right to Warn’ Now_](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=a6ac356cc4&e=a07d75591f).
This panel is open to the press and the public. The event will include a discussion with expert panelists followed by Q&A with live questions from attendees.

On the campaign trail, I've been talking directly with Michiganders across the state – folks like you who are concerned for the future – and **here's what I've been hearing:**
🛟 People are worried about the future of Medicare and Social Security.

🩺 Folks in Michigan and across the country want improved and affordable access to health care.

💰 Working families need real action to create and protect good-paying jobs.

⛓️💥 And many expressed deep concerns about the future of our fundamental freedoms, civil rights, and American democracy itself.
These aren’t just political talking points, null. They’re _real_ concerns from _real_ people. And they’re exactly why I’m running for Michigan's battleground Senate seat – **because I have a track record of getting things done.**

📌 I played a leading role in passing the bill to grow our manufacturing economy by bringing America’s semiconductor industry back to where it belongs: Michigan.
📌 Most recently, I introduced the Stop Trump's Abuse of Power Act – a bill to ban the president from deploying active duty troops on U.S. soil without consent from state or local leaders.
That barely scratches the surface, and I know there's a _lot_ more work to do. So it's a good thing I grew up the Michigan way: surrounded by grease, grit, and hard work. And I'm in this race now so I can continue fighting for Michigan's working families in the U.S. Senate.

| | | | | |
Dear Friends,

As I reflect on life as a new dad to the most adorable three month old, I’ve been thinking a lot about the future. Both our son's future, and the future of the nearly half a million kids we serve in L.A. Unified.
[**That’s why today, I’m announcing my campaign for a final term on the LAUSD School Board**](https://nickmelvoin.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e47425f168c0b7b00df186831&id=5822394e07&e=3cf484ad56)**.**
I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished together despite the challenges over the last few years:
* Driving **record student achievement growth** while protecting the district’s finances
* Implementing the **largest cell phone ban in the country** to help kids focus and learn
* Leading the **largest expansion of preschool** in the state
* Passing **two record-breaking bond measures** to invest billions in our schools
* Launching **affordable housing for educators** on district land

But there’s still so much more to do and it’s important that we finish the work we’ve started. As our kids and communities face attacks from Washington, we need to continue to protect our vulnerable students while pushing achievement even higher and ensuring all kids, regardless of their background, have a fair shake.

This work has never felt more personal to me: as a new dad, I know how important it is to give every child the best possible start in life and I'm more committed than ever to that work.
[**Early strength sends a powerful signal and helps us stay focused on the kids, not fundraising calls. Will you contribute $100 or more today to help us launch this campaign strong**](https://nickmelvoin.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e47425f168c0b7b00df186831&id=25be89b593&e=3cf484ad56)**?**
The more we raise from this email, the fewer of you I’ll have to call. Better for you, and better for me with a newborn at home!
Thank you for supporting me on this journey. Together, let's close out this chapter strong.
---

body:
The Republican Big, Ugly BETRAYAL budget gutted Medicaid, and Americans will pay the price.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116937915/574927580/150430950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OGFhZWY4MS0zYWE1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QklfN0lPmcXrEeJ7KUaMptpzLWKSyMgr4eqz_zZKzxY=&emci=4baaef81-3aa5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=58aaef81-3aa5-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=7731215)
---

| | Across the country, states are preparing to close massive budget shortfalls because Donald Trump's Big Beautiful Betrayal law slashed Medicaid funding by nearly $1 trillion over the next decade. This is the Republican legacy: ripping vital health care away from working families, seniors, and children — all while handing out tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations. The Republican Big, Ugly BETRAYAL budget gutted Medicaid, and Americans will pay the price. Families will be forced to make impossible choices between paying rent and getting the care they need. Rural hospitals are already closing. And people will fall through the cracks of a system that's been deliberately undercut. Democrats are fighting back — to restore the health care families need, to protect Medicaid, and to ensure that no one in America goes without care because of where they live or what they earn. We can still reverse the damage, protect Medicaid, and build a health care system that works for everyone — but only if we keep organizing, speaking out, and standing together. body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NC Newsline: NC House bill would allow elections board workers to be replaced with political hires [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=100925_2&amount=25]
Get this, Team: Opponents of voting rights in North Carolina introduced a sweeping elections bill that, among other steps, would bar election officials from encouraging or promoting voter turnout. This is just the latest and most stark example of a trend among the vote suppressors of opposing even nonpartisan outreach efforts that could boost voting rates.
This bill would also take more than a third of existing nonpartisan staff positions at the state elections office and convert them to jobs for partisan political appointees deeply invested in the results of the elections they would be in charge of. Finally, the measure would add new voting restrictions for military and overseas voters, and ban ranked choice voting.
The bill and proposed ban on promoting turnout “ raises real questions about what democracy means in North Carolina, who really holds the power, who government is answering to ” according to Andrew Garber, a counsel in the nonpartisan Brennan Center’s Voting Rights and Elections Program.
Opponents of voting rights in North Carolina are more focused on expanding and cementing their own power than they are in serving the people and having fair elections. It's just another example of what they'll export around the country if they get away with it here.
This troubling bill has the potential to impact us all, no matter what state we live in. Please pitch in $15 or whatever you can today to help us stop voter suppression in North Carolina and across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=100925_2&amount=15]

Wondering how this impacts you? It's as simple as this: Rep. Allison Dahle, a top defender of voting rights on North Carolina’s House Elections committee, said, “ I think North Carolina has become a testing ground. It’s become a place where they say, ‘let’s see if it works.’ ”
For decades, the voter suppression movement has taken bills that pass in one state and exported them across the country. The leaders at a sprawling, dark money conservative think-tank have taken credit for it, caught on camera bragging about writing the legislation at their headquarters. For example -- the sweeping suppression bill passed in Georgia in March of 2021 was adapted and passed in states like Texas, Florida, and beyond in the months afterward.
It's all just the latest extreme anti-democracy tactic pioneered by North Carolina vote suppressors over the last decade or so. In 2016, a court found that the state’s voter suppression law targeted Black voters with “surgical precision.” They drew multiple gerrymandered maps, and stripped the new governor of several election-related powers before he took office. After the 2024 election, they waged a months-long campaign, ultimately unsuccessful, to overturn a Supreme Court race by having over 65,000 valid votes thrown out after the vote-counting, and two recounts, had been completed. It's not going to end until we stop them.
We have to fight back every time they try to chip away at our fundamental right to vote. Will you chip in $15 or whatever you can today to stop this bill and suppression bills like it nationwide? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=100925_2&amount=15]

| | , Ken Paxton is at it again. **He’s announced an “undercover operation” to infiltrate so-called “leftist terror cells.”**

Because in Paxton’s bizarro-world, you apparently tell your “criminal target” about your undercover plans before launching them. I’ve been a Democrat my whole life! I’ve attended at least a thousand leftist meetings and nobody ever told me about these "terror groups." _I’m pissed!_ **Jokes aside, this is serious.** Paxton is using the power of his office to stoke fear and boost his U.S. Senate campaign. He doesn’t have the legal authority to “launch an operation” in the way he’s describing. He can investigate, litigate, and in rare cases, prosecute. But he **_cannot_** deploy troops, armed agents, or vigilantes to chase political enemies. **This is reckless, inflammatory, and dangerous rhetoric from a man already under indictment for abusing his office. His words could easily incite real violence.** Paxton’s behavior is worthy of impeachment. He’s simply mimicking the outrage and bluster of his mentor Trump, the guru of impeachable conduct. Trump federalizes state national guards; Paxton launches an operation. Paxton is a copycat. And the Texas GOP machine won’t lift a finger to stop him. **That’s why I’m running for Texas Attorney General** : to restore sanity, integrity, and the rule of law to an office that’s been turned into a political weapon. **Texans deserve leadership, not chaos.** [**If you agree, chip in today to help me fight back against Paxton’s dangerous, self-serving antics.**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=4b9d057cbb&e=5d8d80652b) All voters—even traditional Republicans—should abandon Paxton and his ilk in the 2026 midterms. Hi Friend,
Morris County is home to more than 90,000 seniors including parents, grandparents, and neighbors who built this community. They deserve a county government that stands by them.
As Commissioner, I’ve:

* Expanded senior service funding
* Improved transportation for doctor visits and groceries
* Strengthened meal delivery programs
* Fought for property tax relief to help seniors stay in their homes

But we can’t take this progress for granted. Keeping Morris County the best place to live — for our seniors and our youth — takes steady leadership and your support.
Chip in today or help spread the word so we can keep Morris County strong for every generation.
With gratitude, Doug

| | Peter,

San Diego families and businesses are already paying the price for Republicans’ misguided economic policies, and the government shutdown is only adding to the strain with each passing day.

Troops are working without pay, essential services like food assistance are delayed or paused, air travel operations and safety are being disrupted, and millions of Americans’ healthcare costs are about to go through the roof.

Our communities need solutions – now.

**My fellow Democrats and I remain ready and willing to reach a bipartisan agreement to reopen the government, but my colleagues across the aisle refuse to come to the negotiating table.**

#### **JULY - SEPTEMBER**

| |
## **What We Built, Together!**
---
| |
When I launched this campaign just a few months ago, I made a promise: this would be a different kind of movement, one built on a "Community First" mission of real service and real results.
As we close the books on our first full fundraising quarter, I am so incredibly proud and humbled to report back on what we have accomplished, together.
The numbers tell a powerful story: a story of a grassroots movement that is not just viable, but a force to be reckoned with.

| |
### **Community First in Action**
---
| | Our campaign has always been about more than just an election. It's about serving our community now. Here's what your support has already built:
* **July** **& August Clothing Drive:** Together, we collected **12 SUV loads of clothes** from over 80 of our neighbors, delivering them directly to organizations serving single mothers, homeless veterans, and our community members in need.

Thank you for being in this fight with me.

name: Chris Ahuja
subject: The Politics of Cruelty Has No Place in America
body:
America deserves competent and compassionate leadership

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=099055ed9c&e=5a6ee82cdb)
| | | | | |

Dear Peter,
**During the government shutdown, thousands of federal employees have gone without a paycheck**. Families will be struggling to cover rent, put food on the table, and pay bills — all because Disastrous Donald and his Reprehensible Republican Rubber-stampers failed to do their most basic job: keep the government running. And now Donald Trump has said he’ll only approve back pay for some workers, leaving others behind. **Think about that. Hardworking Americans — air traffic controllers, TSA agents, park rangers, scientists, custodians — are working without pay or forced to stay home without income**. And Terrible Trump decided that only certain people deserve to be paid once the government reopens. **That’s discriminatory and hateful. And it’s certainly not American**.**This is the politics of cruelty:** dividing workers into “worthy” and “unworthy,” using livelihoods as leverage, and treating public servants like disposable pawns in a political game. Every federal worker who shows up, serves, and sacrifices deserves fair pay. Period.**No parent, no veteran, no young family should have to endure financial hardship because politicians can’t do their job.** And no leader should add insult to injury by denying workers the pay they’ve earned.**This campaign stands for the people who keep this country running.** From teachers and park rangers to janitors and researchers, they all deserve leadership that honors their work — not divides them.if you believe in fairness over favoritism, decency over cruelty, and leadership that values every American — then stand with us today.**Together, we can send a message loud and clear: the politics of cruelty has no place in America.**

Hi, friend – Congresswoman Brittany Pettersen here, reaching out on behalf of my dear friend and mentor, Michael Bennet.
But before I ask you to**_[split a donation between us toward his critical $10,000 midnight goal,](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116942635/574943599/-1534634276?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk933-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNTAwODUxNi00N2E1LWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0F3GQqs-ilV4MQND1CwwpndDGjS2CZPcaHW6u8xhzKo=)_ **I'd like to share a story – because Michael and I go back a long way:
My work with Michael began in 2010 as an organizer for his Senate campaign. It was a historically tough year for Democrats – but together, we beat the odds and kept Colorado's seat blue by a 1.7% margin, the second closest that cycle.
I continued working alongside him, supporting candidates, ballot measures, and legislation to invest in leveling the playing field for kids and regular people like me. Because, like he's always said: someone's ZIP code should never be the deciding factor in the opportunities they receive.
As Michael prioritized our shared values at the federal level – most notably by nearly _halving_ the national child poverty rate with the passage of the Child Tax Credit – he inspired me to lead the charge from here at home by running for Colorado's legislature.
There, I worked to expand early childhood education, lower health care and medication costs, and create more opportunity for all Coloradans.
And since 2023, I've had the honor of keeping up the fight for those values with Michael on the opposite side of Capitol Hill, as the U.S. representative for Colorado's 7th District.
**All of this is to say: Michael Bennet has been one of my most important mentors, role models, and allies from the very start.**
So 15 years since I first got involved in his grassroots movement to make Colorado the best place to live, work, and raise a family, I'm so proud to still call myself a member of Team Bennet today as he runs to keep up the fight as our next governor. **And ahead of his campaign's biggest public fundraising deadline yet, at 11:59 p.m tonight, I'm counting on you to join me.**
